title: Water sliding triphibian boat capable of vertically taking off and landing and control method of water sliding triphibian boat
abstract: The invention discloses a triphibian boat capable of vertically taking off and landing and sliding in water and a control method of the triphibian boat. The triphibian boat comprises a boat body mechanism, a vertical taking off and landing mechanism, an air flight power mechanism, a water surface and underwater navigation power mechanism and a steering mechanism. The boat body mechanism comprises a boat body, boat wings and an internal cabin body; the vertical take-off and landing mechanism comprises rotor wings, rotor wing power devices, rotor wing supports and telescopic rotor wing protection sealing door plates; the air flight power mechanism is arranged on the boat bow and comprises a telescopic propeller, and a propeller storage cabin is arranged at the front part of the boat body; the water surface and underwater sailing power mechanism comprises a water spraying type propeller and a ballast water mechanism which are arranged at the lower end of the boat tail; the steering mechanism comprises elevators arranged on the airship wings and a rudder connected with the airship tail through a rotating shaft. The triphibian boat can take off and land under severe sea conditions and narrow water areas in a vertical take-off and landing mode, so that the triphibian boat has high maneuverability, and accidents in the take-off and landing process are reduced; the robot can slide in water, energy consumption is effectively reduced, and the robot has high cruising ability in water.
note: flying and diving boat with an internal cabin; crew not stated

title: Underwater bionic snakelike robot and hybrid adaptive control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater bionic robots, solves the technical problems that a traditional snake-shaped robot cannot automatically adapt to environment changes, the motion performance cannot be optimized, and multiple propelling modes of the traditional snake-shaped robot cannot be intelligently coordinated, and particularly relates to an underwater bionic snake-shaped robot and a hybrid self-adaptive control method thereof. Comprising a snakelike robot composed of a snakelike body assembly, a snakelike head assembly and a jet propulsion module. A reinforcement learning intelligent body is used for outputting control instructions for motor joints and control instructions for a jet propulsion module according to real-time environment perception and robot state feedback. The control of the motor joints may be adjusting parameters of the central pattern generator to generate a desired joint angle, or directly outputting a desired drive torque for each motor joint. The snakelike robot is suitable for tasks such as pipeline inspection and underwater detection, the manufacturing cost and the maintenance difficulty are reduced through modular design, and the intelligent level of the robot is improved through an advanced control method.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater charging device for submersible vehicle and realization method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater charging device for a submersible vehicle and a realization method thereof. The underwater charging device comprises a charging base module, wherein the chargingbase module is of a right angular structure; a charging socket and a steel wire rope connector are arranged at the inner side of the vertical right angle edge of the charging base module; a chargingclamp module is arranged on the horizontal right angle edge; the charging clamp module is connected with the steel wire rope connector on the charging base module through the steel wire rope; a hydraulic locking mechanism is arranged inside the charging clamp module; meanwhile, a charging connector module is also arranged inside the charging clamp module; the head part of the charging connector module is connected with the charging socket. The underwater charging device has the advantages that the structure is compact and reasonable; the operation is convenient; an ROV is arranged through a nuclear power submersible vehicle; the underwater charging device is operated to charge the conventional submersible vehicle under the water; the underwater operation duration of the submersible vehiclecan be effectively prolonged; the submersible vehicle exposure rate is reduced; the execution of invisible operation tasks by the submersible vehicle is facilitated.
note: underwater charging base for submersible vehicles (docking infrastructure)

title: ROV propeller, ROV and ROV stator coil encapsulation method
abstract: The invention relates to an ROV propeller. The ROV propeller comprises an ROV body, a current guiding head, a screw propeller, a current guiding cover and a rear end cover, wherein the ROV body is internally provided with a transmission shaft, a concentrating flux sleeve, a stator coil, a bearing and a stator carrier, and the concentrating flux sleeve, the stator coil, the bearing and the stator carrier are successively arranged on the transmission shaft in a sleeving mode; the current guiding head and the screw propeller are mounted on the outer wall of the concentrating flux sleeve, and the propeller is covered by the current guiding cover externally; the stator carrier is used for fixing the stator coil to support the current guiding cover; the rear end cover is arranged at the tail portion of the ROV body, the stator carrier and the rear end cover form an electronic bin in a surrounding mode, and a driving circuit board is arranged in the electronic bin; a magnet is attracted to the inner wall of the concentrating flux sleeve, and the stator coil is internally encapsulated with special glue; and after being charged with electricity, the stator coil drives the magnet to rotate around the stator winding, and the concentrating flux sleeve, the screw propeller and the current guiding head all rotate along with the magnet to generate thrust. According to the technical scheme, the sealing performance of the ROV propeller stator coil can be improved, and the sealing cost of the ROV propeller stator coil is lowered.

title: Underwater robot equipment for marine surveying and mapping
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine surveying and mapping, and particularly relates to marine surveying and mapping underwater robot equipment which comprises an aircraft, the aircraft is used for marine surveying and mapping, and the top surface of the aircraft is fixedly connected with a base; a sealing box is arranged on the top face of the base, the top end of the sealing box is communicated with an air inlet pipe, the air inlet pipe is used for injecting colored air into the sealing box, an air inlet one-way valve is arranged in the air inlet pipe, and a disc is fixedly connected to the top face of the sealing box. A first motor is remotely operated to run, so that the first motor drives a lead screw to rotate, then a sealing assembly seals an air outlet hole, meanwhile, the lead screw drives a push plate to move upwards so as to push gas in a sealing box to be discharged from the air outlet hole, and colored gas flies on a sea area; and therefore, a worker on the mother ship can quickly find the aircraft, and the aircraft can be conveniently recovered from the mother ship.

title: System and method based on marine ecological environment inspection
abstract: Disclosed are a system and a method based on marine ecological environment inspection. The system comprises an unmanned underwater vehicle, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a data processing device. Theunmanned underwater vehicle is configured to autonomously travel to a preset inspection area and monitor the data of the seabed environment in the preset inspection area; the unmanned aerial vehicleis mounted on the unmanned underwater vehicle and is launched after the unmanned underwater vehicle travels to the preset inspection area; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for acquiring picture data of the sea surface in the preset inspection area, and transmitting the picture data to the unmanned underwater vehicle; and the unmanned underwater vehicle is further used for transmitting the picture data to the data processing device. According to the marine ecological environment inspection system and method, compared with the existing marine ecological environment inspection activity, the system has the advantages of being high in inspection efficiency, large in inspection scope, low in cost, high in efficiency, high in personnel coefficient and the like.

title: Wall contact buffering automatic wall separation mechanism, robot applying same and control method
abstract: The invention relates to a wall contact buffering automatic wall disengaging mechanism, a robot applying the same and a control method. The robot comprises a robot body, a crawler-type magnetic adsorption crawling mechanism and a high-pressure water jet cleaning disc, and the wall contact buffering automatic wall separation mechanism is arranged in a fixed side plate in the crawler-type magnetic adsorption crawling mechanism. The wall contact buffering automatic wall disengaging mechanism comprises a motor driving mechanism, a first execution unit and a second execution unit, and the motor driving mechanism is connected with the first execution unit and the second execution unit through a first protruding connecting rod and a second protruding connecting rod on a nut base. The first execution unit and the second execution unit can rotate by a certain angle in opposite directions at the same time, and the effects of wall touching buffering and automatic wall disengaging are achieved. By means of the technical scheme, the problem that when the underwater magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot just makes contact with the wall face, the instant vertical wall face pressure is too large, and consequently the magnetic adsorption unit loses efficacy can be solved, and the robot can be automatically disengaged from the wall face after an operation task is completed.

title: APPARATUS FOR LAUNCHING AND RECOVERY OF UNMANNED UNDERWATER VEHICLE
abstract: Disclosed is an apparatus for launching and lifting of an unmanned underwater vehicle. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for launching and lifting of an unmanned underwater vehicle comprises: a cylinder unit installed on an upper portion of a deck and receiving hydraulic pressure; a piston unit having at least a portion accommodated in the cylinder unit, and moving forward or backward by the hydraulic pressure applied to the cylinder unit; a rotary reel accommodated inside the piston unit and provided to be rotatable, and having a spiral groove formed on the outer circumferential surface in a spiral direction; a case unit disposed in front of the piston unit, and having an unmanned underwater vehicle mounted therein; a lifting line having one end connected to the case unit and the other end connected to the rotary reel, and wound around the spiral groove to be wound around the rotary reel; and a rotating means connected to the rotary reel to rotate the rotary reel when the case unit is lifted. The present invention can reduce an impact applied to the unmanned underwater vehicle by reducing the falling speed of the unmanned underwater vehicle.

title: AUV (autonomous underwater vehicle) four-passage coupling control method
abstract: The invention provides an AUV (autonomous underwater vehicle) four-passage coupling control method. Firstly, attitude sensor and depth sensor data are respectively obtained; all the data is subjectedto wave filtering processing; then, longitudinal plane control calculation, horizontal plane control calculation and transverse rolling calculation are respectively performed; next, rudder angle allocation calculation is performed; the control moment is allocated onto four control surfaces to obtain the rudder angle; next, the speed sensor information is obtained; after the wave filtering, the speed control calculation is performed; a rotating speed control instruction is obtained; finally, the rudder angle and the rotating speed instructions are sent to an execution mechanism to be executed.Through a control algorithm, the single paddle and crossed rudder type AUV realizes the stable navigation by periodically controlling the rudder angle and the rotating speed. In addition, the rudder angle allocation algorithm used in the invention considers the influence of the AUV transverse roller; the method is applicable to the AUV at any transverse rolling angles; particularly when the AUV transverse rolling angle is not zero, the method has better control effects than the conventional static rudder allocation method.

title: ROV fault diagnosis principal component analysis device
abstract: The present invention provides a ROV fault diagnosis principal component analysis device. The present invention relates to the field of the unmanned underwater vehicle state monitoring technology, and discloses a ROV fault diagnosis principal component analysis device. The device comprises a sensor system, an embedded controller, an optical transmitter and receiver and a water surface monitoring system. Each sensor in the sensor system is connected with signal input end of the embedded controller through a signal transmission line, the embedded controller is connected with the signal input end of the optical transmitter and receiver, and the output end of the optical transmitter and receiver is connected with the water surface monitoring system. According to the invention, the search gap of directly serving the unmanned underwater vehicle reliability control technology is filled, and the remotely-operated vehicle (ROV) fault diagnosis principal component analysis method and device are provided to realize innovation in the field.

title: Underwater glider buoyancy driving device
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater glider buoyancy driving device. The underwater glider buoyancy driving device comprises a glider shell, an oil pump, a pump motor, an electromagnetic valve, oil ways, an inner oil bag and an outer oil bag. The inner oil bag is arranged in the glider shell, and the outer oil bag is arranged on the outer portion of the glider shell and exposed out of the glider shell. The oil pump is connected with the inner oil bag and the outer oil bag through the oil ways. Oil stored in the inner oil bag is pumped to the outer oil bag by driving the oil pump through the pump motor. A communicating oil way and the electromagnetic valve used for controlling opening and closing of the communicating oil way are arranged between the inner oil bag and the outer oil bag. The underwater glider buoyancy driving device has the advantages that the aim of controlling a glider to sink and float in water is achieved by controlling the inner oil bag and the outer oil bag to be alternately full, and the underwater glider buoyancy driving device is simple in structure, safe and reliable.

title: INSPECTION AND/OR MAINTENANCE METHOD AND ASSOCIATED APPARATUS
abstract: A method of isolating a sea chest of a marine vessel. The method comprises sealing an inlet (12, Fig 4) to the sea chest with an isolation apparatus 20. The isolation apparatus is both transported through a body of water adjacent the vessel and positioned to cover the inlet using a diverless operation. The method may further comprise transporting the isolation apparatus through the body of water by lowering it on an elongate member (19, Fig 6) to a depth corresponding to the inlet and positioning the isolation apparatus to cover the inlet using an ROV 50. An isolation apparatus comprising a blanking plate and configured for use in the method is also disclosed.
note: sea-chest isolation plate positioned by an ROV

title: Unmanned underwater vehicle path-finding training method and device and unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned underwater vehicle path-finding training method and device and an unmanned underwater vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned underwater vehicles. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the unmanned underwater vehicle can be trained on the basis of continuous judgment and correction of the execution decision of underwater vehicle path finding, so that the unmanned underwater vehicle has certain autonomous judgment capability. The unmanned aerial vehicle trained by the method provided by the invention can smoothly pass through an unfamiliar water area in manners of avoiding, detouring and the like when facing an obstacle according to experience obtained by self training even in a complex underwater environment. Meanwhile, by utilizing the training method provided by the invention, the closer the water area for training the unmanned underwater vehicle is to the actual combat, the more the unmanned underwater vehicle has the capability of automatically finding the way in the actual combat environment, so that the unmanned underwater vehicle can smoothly arrive at the target site to complete the distributed task.

title: AUV three-dimensional airway planning method
abstract: The invention discloses an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) three-dimensional airway planning method, which improves the planning speed and planning speed of an algorithm by improving a particle initialization method, setting a punishment value for entering an obstacle and setting the step length of an added particle moving position. The method mainly comprises the steps of three-dimensional environment abstract modeling, particle position initialization, punishment value setting of entering obstacles, cost function value calculation, particle movement step length setting, cost value comparison of a particle swarm, particle position updating and planning result output. Compared with a traditional quantum particle swarm airway planning algorithm, the three-dimensional airway planning method provided by the invention considers the influence of ocean current factors, so that the algorithm application is wider; meanwhile, compared with two-dimensional air route planning, three-dimensional air route planning is more practical, and the actual navigation requirement can be better met.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: UUV cluster behavior identification method based on DGRU neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a UUV cluster behavior identification method based on a DGRU neural network, which belongs to the field of deep learning. The invention improves the GRU neural network, proposes a DGRU neural network for preventing information loss, and applies the DGRU neural network to establish an under-driven UUV cluster behavior identification model. The invention comprises a data preprocessing stage, a model training stage and a model prediction stage, in particular comprising the following steps: (1) data cleaning is carried out on a UUV cluster behavior data set; (2) training the DGRU neural network by the data set after data preprocessing, and the UUV cluster behavior recognition model is established; (3) acquiring the current software failure data, normalizing the data bythe same method in (1), and then inputting the prediction model obtained in (2) to carry out UUV cluster behavior recognition to obtain the recognition result; the model can be used to accurately identify the underdriven UUV cluster behavior, which overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional UUV cluster behavior identification technology.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Data-driven AUV multidisciplinary optimization method based on state matching
abstract: The invention discloses a data-driven AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) multidisciplinary optimization method based on state matching, which comprises the following steps of: determining disciplines related to an AUV design optimization problem and design variables related to each discipline; setting an optimization target and a constraint condition of the design optimization problem; constructing an analysis environment of the design optimization problem, wherein the analysis environment comprises a shape subject analysis environment, a fluid subject analysis environment, a layout subject analysis environment and a structure subject analysis environment; the genetic algorithm is initialized; in the design space range of the AUV, initial design samples are generated, each design sample is composed of a set of design variables, each design sample serves as an individual, and an initial population is constructed; evaluating a population state and determining an optimization strategy; and aiming at the determined optimization strategy, solving by adopting a genetic algorithm based on an agent model, screening out a non-dominated solution set meeting constraint conditions, and outputting a design vector corresponding to an individual contained in the non-dominated solution set as an AUV optimization design scheme.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Display base for underwater robot
abstract: The invention provides a display base for an underwater robot. The base comprises a box and a supporting plate. The box comprises a box body and a box cover; the box body is of a cuboid structure withthe hollowed top; the supporting plate comprises an adjusting bin body and a T-shaped plate, an opening is formed in the upper end of the adjusting bin body, the diameter of the opening is smaller than the inner diameter of the adjusting bin body, a transverse plate of the T-shaped plate is arranged inside the adjusting bin body, a damping spring is arranged between the transverse plate of the T-shaped plate and the inner bottom wall of the adjusting bin body, and a vertical plate of the T-shaped plate runs through the opening in the upper end of the adjusting bin and is connected with an arcsupport. The display base has the advantages that rubber plates are embedded into the inner side faces of plates of the bottom and sides inside the box body, and extrusion force to the box body and extrusion force of external objects of the box body to the box body when objects inside the box body are too many can be lowered; by arranging the supporting plate, the buffering and protecting effectsof the underwater robot are achieved, and the underwater robot can be conveniently collected and saved.
note: display/storage base designed for an underwater robot

title: Swimming pool cleaning base, cleaning system and control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of swimming pool cleaning, and provides a swimming pool cleaning base, a cleaning system and a control method.The base comprises a bearing assembly, a lifting assembly and a rotating assembly, the lifting assembly comprises a lifting structure, the bearing assembly comprises a bearing panel and a rotating panel which are connected, and the bearing panel can stretch out and draw back in a stacked mode relative to the rotating panel; the rotating assembly can rotate downwards towards the connection end relative to the lifting structure and comprises a rotating support, and the rotating support can drive the filtering unit to rotate. When the base station is in a first state, the lifting structure is in a lowered state, the bearing panel is in a retracted state, the rotating panel is in a first direction, the swimming pool robot stops on the bearing panel, and the rotating support is connected to the swimming pool robot; in the second state, the lifting structure is in a lifting state, the rotating panel rotates to the second direction relative to the lifting structure, and the bearing panel extends out in the second direction relative to the rotating panel. The swimming pool robot has the advantages that the base can be conveniently fished and cleaned, and labor cost is reduced.
note: base station of a swimming-pool cleaning robot

title: Negative buoyancy compensation device applied to unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a negative buoyancy compensation device applied to an unmanned underwater vehicle. The negative buoyancy compensation device can quickly perform negative buoyancy compensation on the vehicle. The negative buoyancy compensation device comprises a buoyancy compensation water tank, a linear motor, an upper push rod, a lower push rod, an upper sealing plug and a lower sealing plug. Two ends of a motor shaft of the linear motor are coaxially connected with the upper push rod and the lower push rod respectively; the upper sealing plug is arranged at the upper end of the upperpush rod, and a through hole matched with the upper sealing plug is formed in the upper end of the buoyancy compensation water tank; the lower sealing plug is arranged at the lower end of the lower push rod; a through hole matched with the lower sealing plug is formed in the lower end of the buoyancy compensation water tank; when the linear motor drives the upper push rod and the lower push rod tomove upwards, the upper sealing plug extends out of the buoyancy compensation water tank, and meanwhile, the lower sealing plug moves upwards into the buoyancy compensation water tank, the two through holes are opened; when the linear motor drives the upper push rod and the lower push rod to move downwards, the upper sealing plug and the lower sealing plug are matched with the corresponding through holes at the same time, and the buoyancy compensation water tank is sealed.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: AUV (autonomous underwater vehicle)-assisted based underwater wireless sensor network positioning method
abstract: The invention discloses an AUV (autonomous underwater vehicle)-assisted based underwater wireless sensor network positioning method. The method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out primary positioning on an unknown node by using a centroiding algorithm; estimating the positioning accuracy of the unknown node according to the number of beacon nodes around the unknown node, the distribution of the beacon nodes and the distance between each beacon node and the unknown node; screening out a plurality of nodes with a low positioning accuracy; and carrying out secondary positioning on the nodes by using an AUV. The method disclosed by the invention is less in calculation and communication consumption, and can fully use the AUV to improve the positioning accuracy of nodes and reduce the positioning errors, therefore, the method is applicable to the positioning of the unknown nodes of underwater wireless sensor networks.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: AUV docking station optical guiding method based on monocular vision
abstract: The invention provides an AUV docking station optical guiding method based on monocular vision. The AUV docking station optical guiding method comprises: arranging a guiding light source; shooting an underwater guide light source image through a monocular camera, wherein the monocular camera is calibrated by adopting an improved Zhang Zhengyou calibration method; acquiring an underwater nonlinear imaging model of the camera, and mapping the guide light source image into the air through a pixel correction formula to generate a corrected image; carrying out light source segmentation on the corrected image based on an improved adaptive OTSU algorithm, and calculating and obtaining a light source center coordinate based on a coordinate of a pixel weighted centroid; and based on the center coordinates of the light source, performing P3P calculation on three pairs of known coordinate points to calculate the pose of the camera so as to obtain relative position information of the camera.

title: Electrically-driven winch power supply device for ROV
abstract: The invention provides an electric drive winch power supply device for an ROV (remote operated vehicle), which comprises a cabinet body and a control system, a transformer unit cabinet, a control unit cabinet, a main power unit cabinet and a water cooling system are sequentially arranged in the cabinet body along the transverse direction, a water-air heat exchange system is further arranged at the top of the cabinet body, and the water-air heat exchange system is connected with one group of interfaces of the water cooling system. The water cooling system is further provided with a secondary water connector, and the control system is electrically connected with the water cooling system and the water-air heat exchange system. The water-water heat exchange mode and the water-air heat exchange mode are compatible, graded water-cooling heat dissipation and independent cavity forming of the high-temperature area and the low-temperature area are achieved, and different engineering ship conditions are adapted while the reliability is improved; the total power and cost of the water-cooling system are reduced.

title: Underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot, and relates to the technical field of underwater machines. The underwater robot comprises a shell; a power shell is fixed to the tail of the shell; a first motort is fixed in the power shell; a transmission shaft is fixed to an output shaft of the first motor; a driving wheel is fixed to the center of the transmission shaft; first rotating shafts are fixed to the two sides of the inner wall of the shell; transmission rods are fixed to the inner rings of the first rotating shafts in a penetrating mode; a driven wheel is fixed in the center of each transmission rod; a driving wheel is in meshed connection with the driven wheels, and a plurality of blades are fixed to two ends of each transmission rod correspondingly. A support is fixed to the bottom of the shell, a hoop is fixed to one end of the support, an air bag is movably connected into the hoop, and an air outlet is fixed to one end of the air bag. Through the action of the blades and the air bag, the robot is simple in structure, the shell can be controlled to operate simply, the manufacturing cost is low, and compared with a traditional underwater robot high in manufacturing cost, the cost performance is higher, and the underwater robot is more suitable for children education, underwater sampling and other activities with the low precision requirement.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Heterogeneous multi-AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) task decision-making method
abstract: The invention discloses a heterogeneous multi-AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle)-oriented task decision-making method, which comprises the following steps of: according to problem description of heterogeneous multi-AUV task decision-making, constructing a constraint condition of the task decision-making in combination with self performance and task requirements of heterogeneous multi-AUV, and establishing a target function of the task decision-making; solving the problem of heterogeneous multi-AUV task decision by using an adaptive genetic algorithm to obtain a task allocation result for each AUV; wherein the fitness function of the adaptive genetic algorithm is constructed based on the target function, and the fitness function is selected based on the constructed constraint condition. According to the method, the problem of premature convergence or too slow convergence speed caused by fixed crossover rate and mutation rate in a traditional genetic algorithm is effectively solved, heterogeneous multi-AUV task decision can be realized, and the solving speed is higher than that of an existing method.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater detection robot
abstract: The invention provides an underwater detection robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The underwater detection robot comprises a robot body, robot legs and adjusting mechanisms, whereinthe robot body comprises a plurality of robot body segments, the adjacent robot body segments are suitable for being in sliding connection, the robot legs are arranged on the robot body segments and are at least suitable for achieving one of the walking function of the underwater detection robot in the walking mode, the propelling function of the underwater detection robot in the swimming mode andthe operating function of the underwater detection robot in the operating mode, and the adjusting mechanisms are arranged between the adjacent robot body segments and used for adjusting the center distance between the robot body segments. According to the underwater detection robot, the multiple robot body segments are in sliding connection to form the robot body, the distance between the adjacent robot body segments is adjusted through the adjusting mechanisms to achieve stretching and retracting of the robot body, and thus the gravity center of the robot body can be adjusted in real time according to the ocean current condition to make anchoring of the robot body more stable; and meanwhile, the walking or propelling or operating function is achieved through the robot legs, and detaileddetection can be conveniently carried out.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Video image real-time enhancement method for underwater AUV
abstract: The invention discloses a video image real-time enhancement method for an underwater AUV. The method comprises the steps of acquiring a sample; constructing a generative adversarial network and training the generative adversarial network; and collecting underwater image data as input of the generative adversarial network, generating a clear image corresponding to a underwater distortion image by using the trained generative adversarial network, and then outputting the clear image as a video stream so that real-time enhancement of the underwater image can be realized. The problem of underwaterimage distortion is solved, real-time image enhancement is realized, and a visual perception capability of the underwater robot is improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: UNDERWATER GLIDER FOR LOCALIZING A SOURCE OF SOUND
abstract: FIELD: acoustics.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to devices for localizing a sound source. Underwater glider contains wings, rudders, engines, battery, control system. Glider contains two spaced apart detectors – fore and aft. Each detector is covered with a soundproof cover and is mounted on the longitudinal of the elastic threads. Data processing system includes a two-channel ADC whose outputs are connected to two-channel units for calculating the vertical and horizontal components of the intensity vector. Horizontal component calculation unit is associated with the azimuth angle calculation unit, aggregate azimuth angle calculation unit, and horizontal component differentiation unit. Unit for calculating the vertical component of the intensity vector is associated with the unit for differentiating the vertical component of the vector. In turn, the differentiation units of both components of the vector are connected with the unit for calculating the horizontal components of the intensity vector rotor, which, in its turn, is connected to the unit for calculating the angular component of the intensity rotor vector in a rotated coordinate system. Unit for calculating an angular component of an intensity rotor vector in a rotated coordinate system is associated with a block for calculating the maximum value of an angular component of an intensity vector rotor.EFFECT: higher accuracy and range of detection of a source of sound.3 cl, 3 dwg

title: AUV underwater charging platform
abstract: The invention discloses an AUV underwater charging platform which comprises a platform plate, a wireless charging device used for charging an AUV is arranged at the top end of the platform plate, supporting assemblies used for supporting the platform plate are arranged at the four corners of the bottom end of the wireless charging device correspondingly, and a buffering assembly used for stopping the AUV is arranged at the top end of the platform plate; through the design of the platform plate, the first supporting leg, the limiting bolt, the locknut, the supporting plate, the fixing rod and the supporting assembly, the second supporting leg slides in the first supporting leg, the second supporting leg can drive the supporting plate to be adjusted at any height, and after the platform plate is located at the horizontal position, the height of the supporting plate can be adjusted. Limiting bolts are inserted into circular holes and circular through grooves in a penetrating mode, so that movement of second supporting legs is limited, fixing rods are installed, a supporting plate is fixedly connected with a riverbed, and therefore it is guaranteed that when the AUV is charged in the wireless charging device, the AUV can be horizontally placed, and the stability of the AUV during charging is guaranteed.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Method for estimating ocean current velocity based on SINS/DVL/GPS integrated navigation information of unmanned submersible vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a method for estimating ocean current velocity based on SINS/DVL/GPS integrated navigation information of an unmanned submersible vehicle, and relates to the technical field of marine environment monitoring and navigation. When the unmanned submersible vehicle sails, the strapdown inertial navigation system is used for collecting acceleration and angular velocity, the Doppler velocimeter is used for measuring the velocity relative to the seabed, and the global positioning system is used for obtaining an absolute position; removing noise, filtering and synchronizing data; fusing and resolving the preprocessed data by using a loose combination or a tight combination; carrying out vector operation on the calculated real speed of the unmanned submersible vehicle and the relative seabed speed measured by the Doppler velocimeter to estimate the ocean current speed; correcting and optimizing an estimation result error by using a self-adaptive filtering algorithm; the method has the advantages of multi-sensor information fusion, high data processing pertinence, multiple navigation resolving modes, effective correction and optimization of errors, consideration of actual marine environment factors and the like, measurement accuracy is improved, real-time monitoring is realized, cost is reduced, and adaptability is enhanced.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: 1500-meter-level hybrid drive type underwater glider
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater robots, and particularly relates to a 1500-meter-level hybrid drive type underwater glider which comprises a glider body, a main control system, a buoyancy adjusting system, a pitching adjusting system, a steering adjusting system, an energy system, a navigation communication system, an emergency load rejection system and a propeller system. The main control system controls the buoyancy adjusting system to adjust the buoyancy of the glider; the pitching adjusting system adjusts the pitching posture by adjusting the position of the gravity center; the steering adjusting system realizes steering motion by adjusting a steering mechanism; the energy system provides energy for all actions of the glider; the navigation communication system is usedfor positioning tracking and data transmission; the emergency load rejection system guarantees recovery when the glider breaks down; and the main control system controls the propeller system to realize accelerated propelling motion. The glider can be widely applied to the rapid detection of water area information and the like.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) unstable process control method considering control input dead zone and saturation characteristic
abstract: The invention relates to a UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) unstable process control method considering control input dead zone and saturation characteristics, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a variable structure control parameter after a depth control target value acts with the output of an observer, outputting variable structure control u, and outputting a dead zone-free control instruction tau through a dead zone compensator. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that 1, a PID algorithm in a traditional active-disturbance-rejection control theory is replaced with a variable structure control algorithm, and the problem of multi-state control switching is effectively solved; 2, a self-correction algorithm based on a minimum mean square error is used for dynamically adjusting variable structure control parameters, so that the control performance of the UUV at different speeds is ensured; and 3, a nonlinear self-adaptive compensator is designed, static compensation of an original method is changed, self-adaptive dynamic compensation of a dead zone of a controller is realized, and stable attitude control under a non-ideal steering engine condition is ensured.

title: Flexible bionic robotic fish capable of changing rigidity of fish body on line
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and provides a flexible bionic robotic fish with on-line variable fish body rigidity, which comprises a bionic fish head and a flexible bionic fish body, and the bionic fish head is connected with the flexible bionic fish body; the flexible bionic robotic fish further comprises a variable-rigidity mechanism, the variable-rigidity mechanism comprises a telescopic assembly located in the bionic fish head and a flexible bionic spine located in the flexible bionic fish body, and the telescopic assembly and the flexible bionic spine are oppositely arranged. Wherein the telescopic assembly is used for doing telescopic motion in the direction of a connecting line between the bionic fish head and the flexible bionic fish body, and the flexible bionic spine is compressed or released through the telescopic motion of the telescopic assembly so as to change the rigidity of the flexible bionic fish body. The flexible bionic robotic fish capable of changing the rigidity of the fish body on line is flexible in movement and stable in shape of the fish body, and the rigidity of the fish body can be changed in the swimming process.

title: The battery charging device for Vehicles
abstract: When taking off and landing, the conventional drone takes off and lands vertically in a take-off and landing manner, and when reaching a certain altitude, a wing portion to which a solar cell plate is attached is formed in a foldable manner, so that the solar cell plate is unfolded using a servomotor as a driving means, electricity is supplied to the motor while charging a secondary battery by the solar cell and supplying electricity to the motor to rotate the propeller to fly. The propeller of the drone rotates 90 degrees using the servomotor as the driving means in the conventional propeller to be a forward type, or a propeller in which the motor and the propeller are integrated is formed on one side of the solar cell plate, and the foldable plate on which the solar cell plate is formed has a cross section convex upward so that lift is generated according to Bernoulli's law.
note: solar charging of an aerial drone

title: Hot-melt autonomous underwater vehicle release method and device thereof
abstract: The invention provides a hot-melt autonomous underwater vehicle release method and device, and the method comprises the following steps: enabling one end of a connecting line to be connected with a beacon, and enabling the other end of the connecting line to be connected with one end of a communication line; arranging a connecting wire and a communication wire on an embedded release part, and fixedly connecting the embedded release part with vulcanized rubber; connecting the other end of the communication line with a watertight plug, and the watertight plug is used for receiving underwater signals; arranging a power supply and a control circuit board which are used for controlling a heating element arranged on vulcanized rubber to heat; heating the vulcanized rubber, reducing the adhesionforce, separating the pre-embedded release piece from the vulcanized rubber, meanwhile, pulling the communication line apart, and releasing the beacon into water. According to the hot-melt autonomousunderwater carrier release method and device, the underwater release process of a small-load carrier can be autonomously realized in an underwater communication mode, the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, and the cost is saved.

title: Autonomous underwater vehicle and operational method
abstract: PURPOSE: An autonomous underwater vehicle and operating method thereof is provided which is navigated in the sea with a control device and a power source for self-movement and without cables for remote control and power transmission. CONSTITUTION: An autonomous underwater vehicle comprises a propeller part(300) installed at a rear part of a ship to propel the ship and control the direction of the ship; a control part(400) controlling various equipments and sensors to automatically control the navigation and execute sea probes; an aquatic optical instrument composed of a TV camera(530) and a still camera(430); a measuring instrument composed of a scan sonar(440), a temperature and conductivity sensor(450), and a speed log(540); an acoustic positioning system transceiver(460) tracking the position of the ship in real time.

title: WATER RESCUE ROBOT
abstract: The invention relates to a water rescue robot having an underwater vehicle (1) which can be remote-controlled or which is autonomous and which has a rescue attachment (2) that is rigidly or releasably connected to the underwater vehicle (1). The rescue attachment (2) has a person securing structure for a person (7) to be received and multiple floating units (5, 6) with a controllable degree of buoyancy. The water rescue robot additionally has a sensor system for detecting the position of a person (7) to be received in the water and a controller which maneuvers the underwater vehicle (1) below the person (7), raises the underwater vehicle until the person (7) is received by the person securing structure, and then actuates the floating units (5, 6) in order to generate buoyancy, by means of which the rescue attachment (2) together with the received person (7) is brought to the surface of the water. The water rescue robot allows an automatic rescue of drowning persons.

title: AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) multi-sensor fusion positioning method based on frequency domain two-dimensional collaborative characteristics
abstract: The invention discloses an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) multi-sensor fusion positioning method based on frequency domain two-dimensional collaborative features. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-sensor time sequence data and an AUV track truth value of time step alignment in a simulation scene; an AUV positioning prediction model is constructed, the AUV positioning prediction model is used for performing frequency domain analysis on the multi-sensor time sequence data along the time dimension and the sensor dimension through a two-dimensional feature transformation module, a dominant frequency is extracted and remodeled, and a remodeled sequence is obtained; a multi-scale feature extraction module extracts multi-dimensional features of the remolded sequence in parallel through multi-scale convolution and fuses the multi-dimensional features to obtain fused features; the adaptive multi-cycle aggregation module weights the fusion features and performs residual connection with multi-sensor time sequence data so as to obtain an AUV prediction position; training an AUV positioning prediction model based on multi-sensor time sequence data and an AUV trajectory truth value; and acquiring multi-sensor data, and realizing AUV positioning based on the trained model.

title: Regional full-coverage path planning method for unmanned underwater vehicle cluster
abstract: The invention discloses a regional full-coverage path planning method for an unmanned underwater vehicle cluster based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: setting constraint conditions in consideration of the cooperative regional coverage task characteristics of unmanned underwater vehicles, and meeting various constraint requirements of a user; the method comprises the following steps: standardizing a cluster collaborative area coverage problem as a partially observable Markov decision process, and establishing an observation state set considering obstacle information, dynamic map coverage rate information and aircraft information; considering a real three-dimensional dynamic underwater task scene, and designing a discrete action space containing six directions of a three-dimensional coordinate system; a feature extractor combining a graph neural network and a convolutional neural network is designed, and multi-dimensional features of detection information are extracted more efficiently; according to the designed reward function considering the individual and collaboration levels, the efficient collaboration task effect of the unmanned underwater vehicle cluster is achieved; the designed additional auxiliary loss function accelerates the training convergence speed.

title: AUV recovery docking dynamic positioning control method based on model predictive control
abstract: The invention discloses an AUV recovery docking dynamic positioning control method based on model predictive control. For dynamic positioning control in an AUV recovery docking process, state estimation is completed through an adaptive unscented Kalman filter algorithm, a state estimation result is compared with an expected state to complete feedback, linear processing is carried out on a linear part in a complex nonlinear system of the AUV, meanwhile, the approximation capacity of an RBF neural network to a nonlinear function is utilized, a compensation amount is generated through an RBF neural network compensator with a self-adjusting function according to the nonlinear part of the AUV, and closed-loop control over a dynamic positioning system is achieved through a model predictive controller. According to the method, a neural network and model predictive control are combined to solve the influence caused by an inaccurate model in the AUV dynamic positioning process, and the dynamicpositioning control precision and stability are improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Sea-air cooperative anti-ocean current interference navigation method based on vision assistance
abstract: The invention discloses a sea-air cooperative ocean current interference resisting navigation method based on vision assistance, which comprises the following steps: acquiring video sequence information of an aerial-view sea area of an airspace through an airspace unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain position information of a remote-control unmanned submersible and ocean current information of the sea area, and providing assistance for navigation of the remote-control unmanned submersible. And meanwhile, an ocean current interference resisting algorithm is added to a control algorithm part of the remote control unmanned submersible, so that the problems of position drift and poor control precision of the remote control unmanned submersible caused by environmental influence of ocean current and the like are solved, and the control and navigation precision of the remote control unmanned submersible is effectively improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: UUV navigational speed duplex control device and method for ocean observation operation
abstract: The invention provides a UUV(Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) navigational speed duplex control device and method for ocean observation operation, which comprises a task control module, a magnitude navigational speed control channel, a precise navigational speed control channel, a motion control module and a sensing module, wherein the task control module is mutually connected with the magnitude navigational speed control channel, the precise navigational speed control channel, the motion control module and the sensing module, and the magnitude navigational speed control channel and the precise navigational speed control channel are all connected with the motion control module. The sensing module captures UUV status, position information and ocean current section information, and then sends the UUV status, the position information and the ocean current section information to the task control module, the motion control module and the task control module to carryout real-time information exchange after the information is processed. The task control module selects different channels according to the current operating condition, and sends digital control quantity corresponding to the current navigational speed command of UUV to the motion control module in order to accomplish the entire navigation speed control procedure. The UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) navigational speed duplexcontrol device and method disclosed by the invention can be applied for cable control debugging and navigational speed control of various kinds of UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) during multiple-operation condition operation.

title: UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) main thruster with visual angle-adjustable visual fault diagnosis device and detection method
abstract: The invention discloses a UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) main propeller with an adjustable visual angle visual fault diagnosis device and a detection method, relates to the UUV main propeller with the fault diagnosis device and the detection method, and aims to solve the problems that the maintenance cost is greatly increased due to the fact that the UUV main propeller is inconvenient to overhaul and the troubleshooting and repairing time of equipment faults is prolonged. A propeller is arranged at the tail end of the vehicle body, the arc-shaped cover is rotationally connected and installed on the vehicle body through a hinge, the fixing plate is installed in the vehicle body in the length direction of the vehicle body, the control element installation mechanism is installed in the vehicle body, and the position of the control element installation mechanism corresponds to the position of the arc-shaped cover. The two detection head adjusting mechanisms are symmetrically mounted at the tail end of the aircraft main body, the detection head adjusting mechanisms are arranged close to the propellers, and each detection head adjusting mechanism is provided with a visual detection probe. The invention belongs to the technical field of UUV fault detection.

title: Control System for a Cable Operated ROV
abstract: The present invention solves the foregoing problems by providing a control system comprising a remote control module in wireless communication with a cable reel module connected to a motor operated cable reel. Advantageously, the remote control module comprises a first user interface for entering instructions and a processor for transmitting the instructions to the cable reel module to extend or retract the cable and thus control the ascent or descent of an ROV attached to the cable. Due to the processor-controlled nature of the control system automated operations of ROV ascent and descent can be realised. Furthermore, the cable reel module itself is provided with a second user interface that can enact a manual override and emergency stop of the ROV motion in the event that the remote control aspect malfunctions or is being operated incorrectly.

title: SUBMERSIBLE VEHICLE WITH OPTICAL FIBER
abstract: A submersible vehicle is provided which includes a housing, an optical fiber coupled with the housing and communicatively coupled with a data acquisition system, and a propulsion system. The propulsion system is configured to propel the submersible vehicle in a fluid at a velocity. The optical fiber is configured to be released at a release rate equal to or greater than the velocity of the submersible vehicle.
note: fibre-guided submersible vehicle (remote)

title: Unmanned ship
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned ship. The unmanned ship comprises a ship body and a main propeller, and the main propeller is arranged at the tail part of the ship body; and the unmanned ship further comprises lateral propellers, the lateral propellers are arranged at the head part of the ship body, and the lateral propellers are used for generating propelling force in an angle with the lengthdirection of the ship body. According to the unmanned ship, the main propeller at the tail part of the ship body is used for generating propelling force, so that the movement is realized; when the extremely small turning radius movement is needed to be realized, the lateral propellers are used for generating the lateral propelling force to be matched with the main propeller, so that the free adjustment of the posture in an extremely small range in a dynamic state can be realized; and therefore, the unmanned ship can be matched with an underwater robot more flexibly, and the cooperative work ofthe unmanned ship and the underwater robot is guaranteed.
note: unmanned surface ship designed to work with an underwater robot

title: Method for controlling shallow water observation-level mini underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses a method for controlling a shallow water observation-level mini underwater robot. The method includes control construction and communication frame; by means of the method, a lower computer main control panel controls three underwater propellers to rotate, controls cameras to switch, controls a switch of an underwater light-emitting diode (LED) lamp and brightness of the LED lamp, and achieves various underwater automation functions (such as automatic depth keeping, automatic come-up and submergence and automatic advance); both-way communication between a deck unit and the underwater robot is achieved, so is communication between a main control chip of the underwater robot and a co-processor ATmega 8, a communication protocol relevant to communication between the underwater robot and the deck unit is formulated, the underwater robot can receive control instructions of the deck unit, and the deck unit can receive state information sent by the underwater robot. Besides, according to the method, feasibility of achieving automatic depth keeping on the basis of an incremental PID algorithm is discussed, and accuracy of automatic depth keeping is analyzed and proved through experimental verification machine data.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Signal processing method for underwater robot positioning system
abstract: The invention discloses a signal processing method for an underwater robot positioning system, and the method comprises the steps: after carrying out the modular two-addition operation of communication data and spreading code data, modulating carrier data based on binary phase shift keying according to a result, and enabling the obtained result to serve as transmitting data A1; after the A1 is received, obtaining data A2 to be processed through signal conditioning and digital acquisition processes; intercepting a segment of to-be-processed data from A2, multiplying the to-be-processed data bylocally generated spreading code data to obtain intermediate data, and recording the intermediate data as A3; performing Fourier transform on the intermediate data A3 to obtain frequency domain data,and performing modulo operation on the frequency domain data to obtain intermediate data marked as A4; comparing the intermediate data A4 with a detection threshold, locking a real frequency, removinga fuzzy frequency, and determining a code phase resolution; obtaining doppler information and code phase information according to the real frequency, and obtaining communication data. The problem that the number of underwater robots contained in a traditional underwater acoustic positioning and navigation system is limited can be solved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater inspection system of bionic robotic fish
abstract: The underwater inspection system comprises underwater base stations, the bionic robotic fish and a central control platform, wherein the underwater base stations, the bionic robotic fish and the central control platform are distributed on the side wall and the bottom of a pool to be inspected; the underwater base station is provided with a controller, and a first communication module and a sound wave generator which are connected with the controller; the bionic robotic fish is provided with a microcontroller, and a second communication module, a sound wave receiver and a micro sensor which are connected with the microcontroller; the second communication module sends the first request signal in a broadcast form; the controller receives the first request signal through the first communication module and controls the sound wave generator to emit a sound wave signal; the sound wave receiver determines relative position information according to the sound wave signal; the second communication module sends the relative position information to the central control platform; and the central control platform controls the bionic robotic fish to cruise according to the relative position information. The system can accurately obtain water quality information of different areas and depths of a water body, and an underwater inspection route of the system is manually controlled.
note: robotic fish inspecting a pool

title: Hull cleaning system
abstract: The invention discloses a hull cleaning system which comprises a cleaning robot, a cleaning object recycling device and a control device, and the control device controls the cleaning robot to clean the outer wall of a hull and controls the cleaning object recycling device to recycle cleaning objects. The cleaning robot comprises a robot body and a cleaning mechanism installed on the robot body. The cleaning mechanism at least comprises a shearing mechanism, an ultrasonic cleaning mechanism and a jet flow mechanism from front to back. The cleaning object recovery device comprises a recovery hopper, a negative pressure absorber and the like and a cleaning object treatment device, the recovery hopper is arranged below the cleaning robot, and the negative pressure absorber is at least arranged at the bottom of the recovery hopper and used for conveying cleaning objects into the cleaning object treatment device. Cleaning operation is rapidly completed during berthing of the ship, the requirement that the ship is cleaned in time and sails in time is met, cleaning objects are recycled while cleaning operation is conducted, and cleaning object garbage is prevented from being generated at the berthing place.
note: hull-cleaning robot

title: Vector propulsion bionic robot capable of actively adjusting posture
abstract: The invention discloses a vector propulsion bionic robot capable of actively adjusting the posture, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots. The vector propulsion bionic robot comprises an umbrella-shaped body module, a tentacle module and a posture adjusting module; the umbrella-shaped body module comprises an umbrella-shaped head part and a skirt-shaped tail part, and the skirt-shaped tail part is formed by a high-elasticity film; the tentacle module comprises swing arms circumferentially installed on the periphery of the umbrella-shaped head, the swing arms can swing in a multi-stage mode towards or away from the axis of the umbrella-shaped head, and the swing arms are sequentially and fixedly connected with the skirt-shaped tail from the head end to the tail end along the axis of the skirt-shaped tail. The posture adjusting module comprises a rotating mechanism and a pendulum bob capable of swinging, and the pendulum bob is eccentrically and rotationally connected to the center of the umbrella top end of the umbrella-shaped head through the rotating mechanism. The rotating mechanism drives the pendulum bob to eccentrically rotate to achieve direction adjustment, the pendulum bob swings to achieve pitching angle adjustment, the swing arm and the skirt-shaped tail are matched to achieve autonomous three-dimensional space swimming posture change, various basic motions are completed in the mode that the goodness of fit with jellyfish motions in real life is high, and the bionic degree is high.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Umbilical cable exit tool for underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater robot auxiliary tool, in particular to an umbilical cable exit tool for an underwater robot. The umbilical cable exit tool comprises a supporting barrel body, asleeve seat, supporting arms, supporting plates, a cable exiting push rod and a hydraulic cylinder, wherein the sleeve seat is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting barrel body, a sleeveseat shoulder is arranged on the inner side of the sleeve seat, the supporting arms are fixedly arranged on the sleeve seat, the upper ends of the supporting arms are connected with the supporting plates through pin rolls, the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged on the supporting plates, and the cable exiting push rod is arranged at the end part of a cylinder rod of the hydraulic cylinder. When the mechanism works, a umbilical cable tail end is arranged in the supporting barrel body, a umbilical cable tail end clamping ring at the upper end of the umbilical cable tail end abuts against thesleeve seat shoulder, and the cable exiting push rod abuts against the upper end face of an umbilical cable in the umbilical cable tail end and is driven to move through the hydraulic cylinder. The tool has the advantages that operation is stable, reliable, convenient and fast, and serious damage to the umbilical cable tail end is avoided.

title: AUV-based small-vector tail propeller device and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a small vector control tail thruster design device based on underwater robot (AUV) design and a control method. The small vector control tail thruster design device is provided with a sealing mechanism, a thruster transmission mechanism, a rotary steering engine fixing mechanism and a controller. According to the device, the movement direction of the AUV is controlled by controlling the orientation of the propeller through the two steering engines, the steering function of a rudder is replaced to a certain extent, and the movement direction of the AUV can be controlled in a vector mode by changing the deflection angle of the rudder according to the actual yaw condition. The invention relates to a control method of a sliding mode variable structure, which is used for carrying out speed control and depth control on navigation of an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle), reducing problems and difficulty caused by a parameter setting process and realizing a faster and more stable control effect.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater event coverage-oriented underwater robot deployment method
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot deployment method for underwater event coverage, which belongs to the field of underwater acoustic sensor network coverage, and comprises the following steps: (1) randomly deploying a plurality of underwater robot nodes around an underwater target event to be monitored; (2) each underwater robot node obtains the number of neighbor nodes, the position of each neighbor node, the number of covered events, and the number of covered events and the number of adjacent nodes in a crowding degree related information sensing range in a communication range of the underwater robot node; (3) according to the acquired neighbor information and event information, making decisions of stopping, inducing movement, foraging movement or random diffusion by the underwater robot node according to the existence of neighbor nodes, coverage events and distance information of the coverage events when the underwater robot node moves each time; (4) each underwater robot node judges whether the underwater robot node meets the coverage condition, if not, the step (2) is returned to continue to execute the step (2) and the step (3), and if yes, the underwater robot node does not move any more. And if all the underwater robot nodes meet the coverage condition, the deployment is completed.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Self-adaptive variable-stiffness flexible tail handle based on non-Newtonian fluid and robotic fish with self-adaptive variable-stiffness flexible tail handle
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater bionic robots, and particularly relates to a self-adaptive variable-rigidity flexible tail handle based on non-Newtonian fluid and a robotic fish with the structure. According to the self-adaptive variable-rigidity flexible tail handle, the rigidity can be automatically adjusted according to the swing frequency of the body of the robotic fish, so that the tail handle completes self-adaptive rigidity adjustment on the driving frequency, that is, the higher the frequency is, the harder the tail handle is, and the adaptive capacity of the bionic robotic fish in different scenes can be further improved. The invention further provides a robotic fish with the self-adaptive variable-rigidity flexible tail handle based on the non-Newtonian fluid, a flexible joint is adopted for the fish tail, a four-cylinder plunger pump is adopted for providing pressure, a pressure regulating valve and an electromagnetic reversing valve are omitted, the fish tail is of a rigid-flexible coupling structure, the two ends of a driving unit are fixed to a connecting body, and the driving unit is connected with the connecting body. An oil conveying pipe and a flexible sensor are further arranged in the fishtail, pectoral fins can rotate, a hydraulic loop is internal circulation, the requirement for cost reduction is met, and underwater swing can be smoother.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Small deep sea detection operation type submersible power supply management system and management method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and in particular relates to a small deep sea detection operation type submersible power supply management system and a management method. The small deep sea detection operation type submersible power supply management system comprises a power management unit and a power distribution unit, the power management unit is connected with a lithium battery pack, the power distribution unit and a submersible control system, and is further connected with an underwater base station power supply through a photoelectric composite cable; and the power distribution unit is connected with a submersible control system, floating body equipment and chassis equipment. A parallel power supply scheme consisting of the photoelectric composite cable and the battery pack is adopted, so that the energy requirement and the maximum sailing power requirement of the submersible in normal working time are met, the wire diameter and the weight of the photoelectric composite cable are reduced, and the flexibility of the submersible in operation is improved; the influence range of a single-point fault is effectively reduced, later maintenance anddebugging are facilitated, and meanwhile, the stability and reliability of deep-sea floating and crawling dual-mode detection operation of the submersible are effectively improved.

title: UNDERWATER VEHICLE
abstract: An underwater vehicle comprising a structure (11) holding six thrusters (12) each defining a thrust vector. The thrust vector of each of the six thrusters (12) is oriented as follows: a first thrust vector and a second thrust vector are disposed on respective first and second planes, said first and second planes being parallel to each other; a third thrust vector and a fourth thrust vector are disposed on respective third and fourth planes, said third and fourth planes being parallel to each other and perpendicular to said first and second planes; and a fifth thrust vector and a sixth thrust vector are disposed on respective fifth and sixth planes, said fifth and sixth planes being parallel to each other and perpendicular to said first, second, third and fourth planes, such that the vehicle is enabled to move in a controlled way along its 6 spatial degrees-of- freedom. A system comprising an underwater vehicle and a control center from which the vehicle is controlled.

title: Bionic underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, in particular to a bionic underwater robot which comprises a robot body and a tail fin. A power module is arranged in the machine body; the power module comprises a first bracket and a second bracket; the connecting shaft is sleeved with a mounting frame, and one end of the first support and one end of the second support are connected with the mounting frame. Two mounting plates are further mounted in the rack, and two propelling assemblies are arranged on the mounting plates; the propelling assembly comprises a first rotating shaft, a mounting disc and a shifting rod; the first rotating shaft is rotationally mounted on the mounting plate; the mounting disc sleeves the first rotating shaft; the two ends of the shifting rod are connected with the two mounting discs respectively; and the driving device is mounted on the mounting plate. The function of controlling the tail fin to swing in a reciprocating mode is achieved, the effect that impact borne by the tail fin during turning is buffered through water flow resistance borne by swing of the tail fin is achieved through alternate driving of the two propelling assemblies, and the problem that the endurance time of the robot can be greatly shortened due to the fact that a damping mechanism and an elastic mechanism are used for controlling the swing frequency is solved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Flying wing layout underwater glider course control method based on rolling auto-disturbance rejection control
abstract: According to the flying wing layout underwater glider course control method based on rolling active disturbance rejection control, the rolling motion and the yawing motion of a flying wing layout underwater glider show strong coupling, course control has the under-actuated characteristic, a horizontal differential rudder is used as an executing mechanism to design an active disturbance rejection controller, and the flying wing layout underwater glider course control method based on rolling active disturbance rejection control is achieved. The controller can realize accurate control of the rolling angle of the flying wing layout underwater glider according to the influence of a differential rudder angle on a rolling channel model, has certain anti-interference capability, and realizes course under-actuated control in cooperation with a course control strategy based on rolling angle switching.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Method and Apparatus to Facilitate Cleaning Marine Survey Equipment
abstract: A marine vehicle 200 is configured to manoeuvre a streamer cleaning unit 205 through a body of water proximate a seismic streamer 104 submerged in the body of water. The marine vehicle then attaches the streamer cleaning unit to the submerged seismic streamer and detaches the streamer cleaning unit from the seismic streamer after one or more passes by the streamer cleaning unit over at least a portion of the seismic streamer. The marine vehicle then manoeuvres the streamer cleaning unit away from the seismic streamer. In an alternative embodiment, the marine vehicle features an interface unit configured to receive commands. Optionally, the manoeuvring of the marine vehicle is performed in response to commands from a remote vessel 105. Optionally, these commands are received via a tether 110. Optionally, the cleaning unit can be self-propelled. Optionally, the marine vehicle remains attached to the streamer cleaning unit during the one or more passes.
note: remotely commanded marine vehicle that places a streamer-cleaning unit

title: AN UNDERWATER SELF-PROPELLED ROBOTIC SYSTEM
abstract: The invention relates to measuring-and-operation remotely-controlled robotic systems to carry out works on the water area floor and to perform maintenance, repairs, and periodic inspection of hulls surfaces, hydraulic engineering and oil and gas infrastructures, and it can be applied for precise determination of deformations, chips, appeared cracks, cavities and other defects on the surface of and inside the inspected object, and as well for maintenance, repairs, extra equipment installation, grouting, slinging and moving objects, including dangerous ones in water areas, and other complicated underwater technical works, including works in remote controlled mode.
