title: Autonomous underwater sailing observation platform security assurance device
abstract: The invention discloses an autonomous underwater sailing observation platform security assurance device. The autonomous underwater sailing observation platform security assurance device comprises a monitoring device, a positioning device, an electronic compass, a temperature and humidity sensor, a water leakage sensor, a forward-looking sonar, a load rejection release device, an acoustic beacon, a satellite communication device, a wireless communication device, a power supply control module and a sailing control system. The positioning, navigation and communication devices are connected with a motoring sensor, an unloading load rejection release device and the sailing control system through the monitoring device. By means of data analyzing, accident precursors are searched, problems are found, and measures are timely adopted to solve the problems, collision avoiding and emergent floating are achieved, accordingly underwater operation of the autonomous underwater sailing observation platform is enabled to be safe and reliable.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater robot path planning method integrating hole repair and information acquisition
abstract: The invention designs an underwater robot path planning method integrating hole repair and information acquisition. The method mainly comprises a modeling process and a solving process. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a coverage scheduling model of the underwater mobile wireless sensor network by taking a coverage rate as a target so as to determine the position of a virtual sensor node; secondly, selecting information acquisition points on the horizontal cruise route to completely collect information detected by the static network; then, based on the virtual sensor nodes and the information acquisition points, constructing a multi-task two-layer path planning model of the underwater robot; and finally, designing a double-layer hybrid algorithm based on an ant colony algorithm, a particle swarm optimization algorithm and an A * algorithm, and planning an optimal path passing through the virtual sensor nodes and the information acquisition points. According to the dynamic monitoring road condition and real-time planning updating, the optimal path of the virtual sensor node and the information acquisition point can be obtained, and the efficiency and accuracy of the underwater robot in practical application can be effectively improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater work system
abstract: An underwater work system (100, Fig 1) comprises a processing device (15, Fig 1) that acquires a relative position of an underwater vehicle 20A-C relative to a surface ship (10, Fig 1) from an acoustic positioning system (40, Fig 1) at the start of searching work. The processing device calculates a position of the underwater vehicle based on the acquired relative position. When a measurement error region 20a-c whose centre corresponds to the calculated position of the underwater vehicle and an expected laid region of a pipeline extending in a predetermined direction overlap each other, the processing device moves the underwater vehicle to such a position that the measurement error region and the expected laid region do not overlap each other, and then, makes the underwater vehicle perform crossing detection in which the underwater vehicle detects the presence or absence of the pipeline while crossing the expected laid region.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater robot target detection method based on machine vision
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot target detection method based on machine vision, which belongs to the technical field of image processing, and comprises the following steps: after shooting underwater images, respectively extracting contour feature maps of a plurality of underwater images so as to highlight the features of the underwater images, and then taking the geometric center of the contour in each current contour feature map as an original point to obtain a target detection result; the pixel point coordinates of each current contour feature map are reconstructed to obtain a plurality of current contour registration maps, and after reconstruction, the differences of the contours on the current contour registration maps are easier to compare, and the current contour registration maps with different feature quantities are selected, so that the processing of underwater images with the same content is avoided, the redundant image data is solved, and the processing efficiency is improved. The number of underwater images needing to be processed by the target extraction neural network is reduced, and then the target extraction neural network is adopted to process each to-be-processed feature map to obtain a target area; according to the method, the contour feature map is firstly extracted, so that interference factors in the underwater environment are greatly reduced, and the accuracy of target detection is improved.

title: Multi-device integrated navigation system and method of underwater robot
abstract: The invention, which belongs to marine equipment, provides a multi-device integrated navigation system and method of an underwater robot. The system comprises a strapdown inertial navigation device, aglobal satellite positioning system, a Doppler log, a depth meter, an ocean current meter, a propulsion motor and an electronic chart. The Doppler log obtains absolute speed information and off-bottom height information of the water bottom by an underwater robot in real time after the underwater robot is arranged in water; the depth meter outputs navigation depth information of the underwater robot in real time; the ocean current meter outputs an ocean current speed and direction in real time; the propulsion motor outputs the rotation speed of the propulsion motor in real time; and the strapdown inertial navigation device receives related information outputted by the global satellite positioning system, the Doppler log, the depth meter, the ocean current meter and the propulsion motor, reads map information of the electronic chart through an integrated navigation fusion algorithm, and outputs position information, attitude information and speed information of the underwater robot in real time to form accurate navigation and positioning information of the underwater robot.

title: Observation-level underwater robot umbilical cable management system
abstract: The invention discloses an observation-level underwater robot umbilical cable management system which comprises a mechanical flow meter, a camera, a depth meter, a steel cable winch, a locking motor, an underwater illuminating lamp, an ROV umbilical cable tensioner and an underwater robot umbilical cable. A steel cable winch is arranged at the top of the umbilical cable management system; the mechanical flow meter, the camera, the depth meter, the locking motor, the underwater illuminating lamp and the ROV umbilical cable tensioner are all mounted in the umbilical cable management system; the umbilical cable of the underwater robot penetrates through the umbilical cable management system from top to bottom and sequentially penetrates out of the ROV umbilical cable tensioner and the locking motor in the umbilical cable management system, and after the umbilical cable of the underwater robot penetrates out of the lower portion of the umbilical cable management system, the lower end of the umbilical cable of the underwater robot is connected with the underwater robot. By using the umbilical cable management system, the observation-level underwater robot can carry out underwater operation under the condition that the sea condition is relatively severe, and the applicability of the observation-level underwater robot in operation in the ocean can be improved.

title: AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) dynamic integrated positioning method based on visual fusion
abstract: The invention relates to an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) dynamic integrated positioning method based on visual fusion, which comprises the following steps: firstly, in an underwater environment, an integrated AUV acquires a marker image at the rear part of a target AUV by using two monocular cameras in a binocular vision system mounted at the front part of the integrated AUV, and the marker image is divided into a left image and a right image; according to the left image and the right image, thesize of the marker is acquired by resolving a binocular vision algorithm to obtain the size of the marker; in the underwater docking process, the integrated AUV utilizes two monocular cameras in a binocular vision system installed on the front portion of the integrated AUV to obtain images of markers on the rear portion of the target AUV, and according to the sizes of the markers obtained through calculation, two sets of positioning results are obtained through calculation by utilizing a monocular vision positioning algorithm; and weighted fusion is performed on the obtained two groups of positioning results to obtain a final AUV dynamic integrated positioning result. The single-purpose precision is ensured, the problem of high loss rate of binocular vision is solved, and relatively accurate positioning information is provided for dynamic docking control.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: AUTONOMOUS IN-FLUID ROBOTIC SYSTEM
abstract: An autonomous underwater robotic (AUR) vehicle for use in pipe inspection including (a) a main body configured for housing a controller coupled to one or more sensors; (b) a propulsion system having one or more thrusters configured for propelling the AUR vehicle through a target system; (c) a rechargeable power source provided in the main body and coupled to the controller; (d) a data storage module coupled to the one or more sensors configured for storing and transmitting any acquired data from the one or more sensors; (e) at least one camera configured for capturing images; and (f) a navigation system configured to direct the AUR vehicle and finding a docking station for data transfer and power recharge.
note: autonomous robot inspecting water pipes

title: Rapid buoyancy adjusting system for small and medium-sized unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid buoyancy adjusting system for a small and medium-sized unmanned underwater vehicle. The rapid buoyancy adjusting system comprises a storage water tank, a first water pump, a second water pump, a first one-way valve, a second one-way valve, a first liquid level sensor, a second liquid level sensor, a third liquid level sensor, a fourth liquid level sensor, a third one-way valve and a fourth one-way valve. A top cover, a water passing hole and an inlet connector are fixed to the top of the storage water tank, and a water collecting groove and an outlet connector are arranged at the bottom of the storage water tank. The first liquid level sensor, the second liquid level sensor, the third one-way valve and the fourth one-way valve are all installed on the top cover. And the third liquid level sensor and the fourth liquid level sensor are arranged at the water collecting groove. The side wall of the storage water tank is provided with a fixing frame used forbeing fixedly connected with an underwater vehicle. A water flow inlet of the first water pump is connected with a bottom outlet joint of the storage water tank; a water outlet of the first water pumpis connected with the first one-way valve, and a water outlet of the second water pump is sequentially connected with the second one-way valve, the water injection pipe and the storage water tank.

title: Method and device for many-to-many pursuit game of unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a many-to-many pursuit and escape game method and device for unmanned underwater vehicles, and relates to the technical field of cluster control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the positions of a plurality of vehicles, the vehicles comprising pursuit parties and escape parties; respectively constructing motion models of the aircraft based on the position of the aircraft; based on cooperative detection, the pursuing party locates the escape party and determines a target escape object, and the escape party locates the pursuing party and determines a target pursuing object; based on the target pursuit object and the target escape object, establishing a first optimization algorithm between the pursuit party and the target escape object and a second optimization algorithm between the escape party and the target pursuit object; and jointly solving the first optimization algorithm and the second optimization algorithm, and determining the behavior action of the pursuit party and the behavior action of the escape party. According to the invention, many-to-many pursuit game control of the unmanned underwater vehicle can be realized.

title: Five-degree-of-freedom ROV nonlinear kinematics modeling method
abstract: The invention discloses a five-degree-of-freedom ROV nonlinear kinematics modeling method. The method comprises: establishing a coordinate system and expression of motion parameters; establishing a conversion relation between each linear velocity and a spatial attitude and between the angular velocity and an attitude angle in a body-following coordinate system and an inertial coordinate system; establishing an ROV dynamic model; carrying out stress analysis on the ROV; establishing ROV hydrodynamic models including an inertial hydrodynamic model and a viscous hydrodynamic model; and establishing an open-frame ROV nonlinear motion equation. According to the invention, the construction work of the open-frame ROV kinematics mathematical model is realized based on the vectorization modeling idea; the influence of ROV geometric asymmetry on hydrodynamic force and the influence of a nonlinear part in the hydrodynamic force are considered, a kinematic model is simplified as much as possible on the premise of reflecting asymmetry and nonlinear terms, and the method has enough precision to be applied to motion simulation of the open-frame ROV.

title: DEEP-SEA MULTIFUNCTIONAL LONG-TERM IN-SITU OBSERVATION SYSTEM
abstract: A deep-sea multifunctional long-term in-situ observation system, comprising a mother ship (27), a hoisting and releasing unit, an instrument unit, and an in-situ base. The mother ship (27) is connected to an armored cable hoisting adapter (2) of the hoisting and releasing unit by means of an armored cable of a winch; a hoisting and releasing butting skirt opening (7) of the hoisting and releasing unit can be butted to a top butting needle (10) of the instrument unit, and the top butting needle (10) of the instrument unit can be grabbed and released by a grabbing assembly (8) of the hoisting and releasing unit, so that the instrument unit can be grabbed and released by the hoisting and releasing unit; a bottom slide butting member (11) of the instrument unit can be butted to a base butting skirt opening (18) of the in-situ base, so that the in-situ observation base can be charged by the instrument unit for data acquisition, storage and transmission. Different sensors can be mounted in the system to implement long-time in-situ fixed-point continuous monitoring operation for different parameters of deep-sea seabed.
note: deep-sea observation lander and hoisting unit, not a vehicle

title: Hybrid power unmanned sailing boat driven by wave energy, solar energy and wind energy
abstract: The invention discloses a hybrid power unmanned sailing boat driven by wave energy, solar energy and wind energy, which can carry related water quality detection sensors and camera monitoring equipment and is used for mobile cruise monitoring and water quality detection in a large water area space. The ship structurally comprises an overwater ship body part, an underwater umbilical cord and an underwater glider, the overwater ship body part comprises a wind energy unit, a solar energy unit and an overwater control unit; the underwater glider comprises an underwater structure unit, an underwater control unit and an underwater movement unit. The whole system can realize multi-source power fusion on an energy structure through complementation and coordination of wind energy, wave energy and light energy, and can effectively cope with various weather environments and different surrounding natural conditions in the operation process so as to complete long-term operation tasks.
note: wave/solar unmanned sailing boat with a submerged glider unit

title: Cabin door system of underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, in particular to a cabin door system of an underwater robot. The cabin door system includes a left cabin door mechanism B and a rightcabin door mechanism A which are symmetrically arranged on two sides of an underwater robot, wherein the left cabin door mechanism B and the right cabin door mechanism A have the same structure; eachcabin door mechanism comprises a rotation driving mechanism, a cabin door skin assembly, a cabin door rotating shaft, a cabin door upper connecting piece and a cabin door lower connecting piece; thetail end of the cabin door skin assembly is connected with the cabin door rotating shaft, and the upper end and the lower end of the cabin door rotating shaft are connected with a keel frame of the underwater robot through the cabin door upper connecting piece and the cabin door lower connecting piece respectively; and the rotation driving mechanism is arranged on the cabin door upper connecting piece and connected with the cabin door rotating shaft. The cabin door system of an underwater robot has the characteristics of small navigation resistance, high strength, light weight, convenience indisassembly, flexibility in control and the like.

title: Simulation experiment platform for multi-AUV underwater cooperative operation
abstract: The invention discloses a simulation experiment platform for multi-AUV underwater cooperative operation. The platform is a multi-AUV cooperative platform obtained by expanding a plurality of single AUV simulation platforms which communicate with one another. The upper computer and the remote control ship assembly or the ROV form a single AUV simulation platform. Sensor information of the simulatedAUV is collected, each single AUV simulation platform carries an MOOS platform on an upper computer, and the single AUV simulation platform is composed of a data communication module, a fusion navigation module, a planning decision module and a motion control module. According to the design, a multi-AUV message communication scheme is realized, and the reliability is ensured by using a heartbeatdetection mechanism; multi-source sensor information with different rates can be fused, the problem of sensor measurement delay is solved, outliers can be automatically detected and eliminated, and the navigation precision is improved; the platform has the advantages of simple experimental process, high debugging efficiency, low design cost, good expansibility, high reliability and the like; and experiments prove that the platform has a wide application prospect.

title: Detection device with deep diving function and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a detection device with a deep diving function and a detection method thereof. The detection device with the deep diving function comprises a main rotor mechanism, four groups of auxiliary rotor mechanisms, an auxiliary rotor folding and unfolding mechanism, four underwater propellers, a pressure-bearing cabin, a rotor mechanism fixing frame and a shell. According to the detection device with the deep diving function, the four underwater propellers are used for propelling underwater, the detection device can overcome the buoyancy effect to achieve diving and underwater maneuvering movement, and detection of a deep sea area environment is achieved; the four groups of auxiliary rotor mechanisms can swing downwards and retract, so that the resistance in the diving and floating processes is reduced, and meanwhile, the gravity center of the detection device moves downwards, and the stability of the detection device in water is facilitated; the four groups of auxiliary rotor mechanisms are controlled to swing to horizontal positions by using the auxiliary rotor folding and unfolding mechanism, so that the flight lift force and the air flight cruising ability of the detection device are improved; the height gauge is used to realize grounding prevention of the detection device.
note: aerial-underwater detection drone that dives with underwater propellers

title: Underwater robot cable winch and winding measurement control system thereof
abstract: The underwater robot cable winch and the winding measurement control system thereof comprise a roller used for winding a cable and a cable arrangement assembly used for straightening and limiting the cable, and the cable arrangement assembly is arranged on the peripheral side of the roller and can slide in the cable winding process; the roller comprises a rolling shaft and supporting wheels located at the two ends of the rolling shaft, an arc-shaped cover is arranged between the two supporting wheels, and the arc-shaped cover and the surface of the rolling shaft are spaced. The side, facing the rolling shaft, of the arc-shaped cover is provided with a distance measuring dot matrix used for measuring the distance between the inner wall of the arc-shaped cover and the surface of the cable. The supporting wheel is provided with a laser sensing dot matrix used for sensing whether the cable exists on each layer in the radial direction. A signal transmitting device is arranged on the cable arranging assembly, a receiving dot matrix is arranged on the side wall, away from the rolling shaft, of the arc-shaped cover, and the receiving dot matrix and the distance measuring dot matrix are arranged in the axial direction of the arc-shaped cover and correspond in a one-to-one mode in the axial direction of the arc-shaped cover. According to the cable storage device, cables can be stored more regularly and are not prone to winding and knotting.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Flexible foldable wing device applied to underwater robot
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible foldable wing device applied to an underwater robot, which belongs to the technical field of underwater robots and comprises a bottom plate and a cover plate with the same appearance, wherein the bottom plate is provided with the following parts: a rhombic telescopic mechanism arranged on the bottom plate and formed by connecting a plurality of crossed ribs, anda flexible skin which can be unfolded or folded along with the telescopic mechanism is fixed on the telescopic mechanism; a locking mechanism used for locking the telescopic mechanism when the telescopic mechanism is folded and unfolded; a water inlet electrode that triggers the locking mechanism to unlock the telescopic mechanism after detecting that the underwater robot enters water; after the bottom plate and the cover plate are covered, a gap for the telescopic mechanism to pass through is formed in the side surface. The locking mechanism has a double-locking function and can lock the telescopic mechanism when the telescopic mechanism is folded and unfolded, and through locking of the telescopic mechanism when the telescopic mechanism is unfolded, the skin is prevented from being lifted by stormy waves or swinging unstably. After the bottom plate and the cover plate are covered, the telescopic mechanism can be completely retracted into a cavity formed by the bottom plate and the cover plate, so that the wing is small in overall size and more compact in structure in a retracted state.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Magnetic coupling structure for wireless charging of autonomous underwater vehicle and autonomous underwater vehicle system
abstract: The invention discloses a magnetic coupling structure for wireless charging of an autonomous underwater vehicle and an autonomous underwater vehicle system. The magnetic coupling structure comprises atransmitting end arranged on a charging dock and a receiving end arranged on an autonomous underwater vehicle, wherein the transmitting end includes a transmitting magnetic core and a transmitting coil wound on the transmitting magnetic core; and the transmitting magnetic core includes an elongated main body and at least two winding portions located on the main body, and the transmitting coil includes split coils wound on the at least two winding portions. The magnetic coupling structure for wireless charging of the autonomous underwater vehicle provided by the invention solves the problems of poor endurance and difficult charging of the autonomous underwater vehicle. The receiving end of the magnetic coupling structure is small, occupies small internal space of the AUV, does not change the shape of the AUV, has stronger tolerance for misalignment, and reduces the docking accuracy of the AUV.

title: Pipeline fixing clamp used on remote operated vehicle
abstract: Provided is a pipeline fixing clamp used on a remote operated vehicle. The pipeline fixing clamp comprises a bottom plate, a slider, a hinge, a left support, a right support, a left claw, a right claw, a left slide wheel and a right slide wheel and a spring. The upper surface of the bottom plate is connected with the lower surface of the remote operated vehicle (ROV) through screws. A slide way isarranged in the bottom plate and provided with the slider. The side face of the slide way is in clearance fit with the side face of the slider. The upper surface of the slide way coincides with the lower surface of the slider. The hinge is welded to the upper surface of the slider. The lower surface of the hinge coincides with the upper surface of the slider. The left support and the right support are installed on the hinge. Power is provided by a propeller of the ROV, the rotation of the left support and the right support is converted through a linear guide rail and slider mechanism, and therefore the rotation of the claws on the supports is driven, and finally the clamp exerts clamping force on a pipeline through conversion. The pipeline fixing clamp is simple in structure and easy to assemble and detach, can effectively prevent the ROV from shaking and swinging and ensures the working reliability.

title: Underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater operation, and discloses an underwater robot. The underwater robot comprises a frame assembly which can move and defines a lifting space; the lifting device comprises a first lifting driving device and a bearing device which are detachably connected, the first lifting driving device is arranged on the frame assembly, and when the first lifting driving device is connected with the bearing device, the first lifting driving device can drive the bearing device to ascend and descend in the lifting space; the limiting device comprises a key rod and a lock piece, the key rod can drive the lock piece to be unfolded or folded, and the bearing device is connected with the lock piece; when the first lifting driving device drives the bearing device to move to the target position, the key rod drives the locking piece to be unfolded, so that the locking piece is suitable for being limited with the fixed matching piece, and movement of the bearing device is limited. And the underwater robot can improve the stability and sea wave impact resistance of the bearing device and autonomously complete underwater transportation and long-term fixing operation, so that the underwater operation efficiency is improved.

title: SYSTEM, METHOD, AND COMPUTER PROGRAM PRODUCT FOR MONITORING AN ENVIRONMENT WITH A SWARM OF AUTONOMOUS UNDERWATER VEHICLES AND COLLABORATIVE NAVIGATION
abstract: Provided is a system, method, and product for monitoring an environment with a swarm of autonomous underwater vehicles. The system includes at least one processor configured to determine 3D data of at least a portion of an environment of the at least one AUV, determine, based on the 3D data, at least one object and a position of the at least one object in the environment, receive, from at least one other AUV of the plurality of AUVs, data representing the at least one object and the position of the at least one object, and generate, while traveling in the swarm, updated 3D data based on the 3D data and the data representing the at least one object and the position of the at least one object from the at least one other AUV.

title: UUV three-dimension sea route planning method in moving obstacle environment
abstract: The invention relates to a UUV three-dimension sea route planning method in a moving obstacle environment. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1, establishing a UUV three-dimension obstacle avoidance cost function by calculating the time when a UUV encounters a fixed obstacle and a moving obstacle; step 2, establishing a UUV three-dimension target-approaching cost function by calculating the angle relation between the heading direction of the UUV and the target direction; and step 3, establishing a UUV three-dimension sea route planning cost function by combining the UUV three-dimension obstacle avoidance cost function and the UUV three-dimension target-approaching cost function.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Simulation/graph display cabinet applied to underwater unmanned vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a simulation/graph display cabinet applied to an underwater unmanned vehicle. The cabinet comprises an upper cabinet body and a lower cabinet body, wherein a dual-redundancy interchanger in the upper cabinet body is connected to a control computer and conducts data interaction with the control computer; the dual-redundancy interchanger is also connected to a network interchanger; a graph display computer is connected to a display for data display, is connected to a keyboard and a mouse, and is connected to the interchangers for dual-way communication; in the lower cabinet body, the control computer is connected to a simulation industrial control computer by a simulation signal control box for data communication; and the simulation industrial control computer is connected to the interchangers and a keyboard-display all-in-one machine. The cabinet disclosed by the invention is used to simulate internal and external environments during sailing of the unmanned underwater vehicle, so the vehicle can run in a virtual environment. Furthermore, correctness, validly and reliability of system control software of the unmanned underwater vehicle can be ensured.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Battery pack and cooling device for UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle)
abstract: The invention discloses a battery pack for a UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) and a cooling device, and relates to the technical field of battery pack heat dissipation. The cooling device comprises a front heat dissipation end plate, a front capillary tube welding plate, a cooling capillary tube, a rear capillary tube welding plate and a rear heat dissipation end plate, cooling fins are arranged on the outer side of the front heat dissipation end plate, a communication water channel is milled in the inner side of the front heat dissipation end plate, and one end of the cooling capillary tube is fixed through the front capillary tube welding plate and communicated through the communication water channel of the front heat dissipation end plate; radiating fins are arranged on the outer side of the rear radiating end plate, communicating water channels are milled on the inner side of the rear radiating end plate, and the other ends of the cooling capillary tubes are fixed through a rear capillary tube welding plate and are communicated through the communicating water channels of the rear radiating end plate; the cooling capillary tube penetrates through the unit battery of the UUV, and the penetrating direction of the cooling capillary tube is the same as the axial direction of the single battery in the unit battery. According to the invention, cooling of the UUV battery pack can be realized under a relatively high-rate discharge working condition.

title: Composite drive type bionic amphibious robot
abstract: The invention discloses a composite drive type bionic amphibious robot which comprises a shell, a plurality of telescopic thorns capable of stretching out and drawing back along the outer surface of the shell are arranged on the shell, a sealed cabin, a control device and a sinking and floating device are arranged in the shell, the control device is arranged in the sealed cabin, and the control device adjusts the water-air ratio through the sinking and floating device to enable the robot to float and sink. The telescopic thorn comprises an outer stand column, a middle stand column, an inner stand column, a worm, a worm gear driven block, a first motor, a small lead screw and a large lead screw, the outer stand column, the middle stand column and the inner stand column are mutually nested, the first motor is connected with the worm, the worm is connected with the small lead screw through the worm gear driven block, the small lead screw is in threaded nested connection with the large lead screw, and the inner stand column is connected with the large lead screw. The inner column is provided with a shaftless water jet propulsion device, and the outer column is provided with a water inlet and outlet device close to the middle column. The shape and the driving mode can be adjusted according to different external environments, and intelligent obstacle avoidance and flexible movement can be realized on land and water, particularly on non-smooth grounds such as sand and gravel.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Bionic underwater vehicle
abstract: The bionic underwater vehicle comprises a shell assembly and a driving assembly, the shell assembly comprises a bionic shell, the interior of the bionic shell is hollow, through holes are formed in the two back-to-back sides of the bionic shell respectively, and the driving assembly comprises two flapping fins, two propeller parts and at least one first driving part; the two flapping fins are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the bionic shell, connected to the bionic shell and used for driving the bionic shell to advance and turn, the propeller part is slidably connected to the bionic shell in the axial direction of the through hole, and the first driving part is connected to the propeller part and used for driving the propeller part to slide into or slide out of the bionic shell in the axial direction of the through hole. When the propeller part is located outside the bionic shell, the propeller part is used for pushing the bionic shell to move forwards, turn and retreat. The problem that in the prior art, only propeller propelling or fin flapping gliding is used as power, and therefore the movement requirement of ocean observation in a complex sea area cannot be met in a matched mode can be solved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater robot positioning and navigation device and method
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater positioning and navigation device, in particular to an underwater robot positioning and navigation device and method, which are used for positioning an underwater robot under water in a three-dimensional space, and the underwater robot positioning and navigation device comprises a buoy navigator floating on the water surface and connected with the underwater robot through a communication cable; a positioning sensor is arranged on the buoy navigator and is used for positioning the buoy navigator; the signal processing control unit is in communication connection with the positioning sensor, the buoy hydrophone and the robot hydrophone; the buoy hydrophones are connected to the buoy navigator, are submerged in water and are used for acquiring far-field operation sound; and the at least one robot hydrophone is connected to the underwater robot and is used for acquiring near-field operation sound. Compared with the prior art, the problems of poor positioning precision, difficult path planning and low navigation efficiency of the underwater robot in the prior art are solved, and the absolute position of the underwater robot is determined by acquiring the relative position of the underwater robot and the absolute position of the buoy navigator.

title: Propeller thrust control method for underwater robot driving
abstract: The invention discloses a thruster thrust control method for underwater robot driving. Comprising the following steps: firstly, constructing an extended state observer and a direct adaptive robust controller of the underwater propeller; then, the real-time state of the underwater propeller is obtained, the expansion state observer carries out expansion state observation according to the real-time state of the underwater propeller and then outputs an external interference compensation value, and the direct self-adaptive robust controller outputs the expected torque of the underwater propeller according to the real-time state of the underwater propeller and the external interference compensation value; and then propeller nonlinear compensation is carried out, actual current is obtained, and the underwater propeller is controlled by using the actual current. According to the method, the thrust of the underwater propeller can be controlled in real time, and the problems of incomplete model hydrodynamic characteristic description, uncompensated dead zone characteristics and inaccurate disturbance estimation under the actual working condition of the underwater propeller are solved, so that the thrust control error of the propeller is reduced, the system stability is ensured, and the control performance is improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Miniature controller for underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to a miniature controller for an underwater robot. The controller comprises a controller main body; an ARM embedded system is arranged in the controller main body; the underwaterrobot is provided with a sensor system; the ARM embedded system is connected with a remote operation controller on the ground through a communication interface; the ARM embedded system is connected with four propellers of the underwater robot; the propeller includes a plurality of direct-current motors mounted on the underwater robot; the plurality of direct-current motors are connected with a waterproof motor propeller; the plurality of direct-current motors include a first direct-current motor that controls the forward movement of the underwater robot, a second direct-current motor that controls the backward movement of the underwater robot, a third direct-current motor that controls the upward movement of the underwater robot, and a fourth direct-current motor that controls the downward movement of the underwater robot; and the ARM embedded system is provided with a built-in STM32 series microcontroller. The miniature controller can accurately control the underwater travel, position detection and attitude control of the robot and provide convenience for underwater detection, underwater measurement, underwater salvage and the like.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Visual positioning and close-range dense formation method for underwater robot cluster
abstract: The invention discloses a visual positioning and close-range dense formation method for an underwater robot cluster. The method comprises a vector and scalar marker lamp group module, an omnidirectional underwater high-definition camera module and an image processing and formation control module. When a plurality of underwater robots execute a formation task, all the underwater robots turn on the vector and scalar marker lamps and acquire optical images formed by the vector or scalar marker lamps of other adjacent underwater robots through the omni-directional underwater high-definition camera group; and image processing is carried out on the obtained image, calculating space three-dimensional coordinates and postures of a plurality of adjacent underwater robot targets, and a control instruction is calculated according to a formation task to form a stable underwater robot formation. According to the method, high-precision visual positioning is realized on an underwater robot carrier, and stable underwater robot cluster formation under a non-communication condition is realized on the basis. An underwater robot cluster carrying the method can freely switch the formation in autonomous navigation without modifying any hardware settings.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Autonomous underwater robot and path following control method and device
abstract: The embodiments of the invention provide an autonomous underwater robot and path following control method and device and relate to the robot technology field. The method comprises the following stepsof obtaining a built autonomous underwater robot motion system; generating a nonlinear dynamic system of the autonomous underwater robot motion system according to a physics principle; receiving a real-time position acquired by the positioning module of the autonomous underwater robot, and rewriting the real-time position according to a dynamic model; and generating a nonlinear robust inverse stepcontroller based on a disturbance term of the autonomous underwater robot, the real-time position and a preset input-state stability theory, and controlling the autonomous underwater robot motion system so that the autonomous underwater robot autonomously and independently completes precise path following operation and achieves stable operation.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Primary-secondary type cross-medium aircraft capable of realizing underwater mooring inspection and operation method of primary-secondary type cross-medium aircraft
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation and ships, and discloses a primary-secondary type cross-medium aircraft capable of realizing underwater mooring inspection, which comprises an amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle platform, an underwater launching and recycling platform and an underwater aircraft inspection platform, and is characterized in that the amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle platform comprises a shell, an illuminating lamp, a pan-tilt camera and a propeller; the aerial vertical propeller, the underwater vertical propeller and the underwater horizontal propeller are connected with the shell through a support, a beacon storage device is installed at the top of the shell, the bottom of the shell is connected with the underwater laying and recycling platform, and the underwater laying and recycling platform comprises a beacon laying and recycling device and an underwater vehicle laying and recycling device. And the underwater vehicle inspection platform is connected with the underwater launching and recycling platform through the underwater vehicle launching and recycling device. The child-mother type operation system of the device has the double advantages of an aerial unmanned aerial vehicle and an underwater vehicle, the requirement for executing aerial and underwater multi-scene operation tasks is met, and the problem that the operation scene is single is practically solved.
note: cross-medium aerial drone carrying an underwater inspection vehicle

title: Tendon rope driven underwater dexterous hand
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater dexterous hand driven by a tendon rope, and relates to the technical field of underwater dexterous hands. In order to overcome the defects that in the prior art, an existing operation type underwater robot is single in grabbing mode and poor in flexibility, and the technical problem that a conventional underwater mechanical arm is difficult to conduct efficient, lossless and self-adaptive grabbing on underwater creatures, the technical scheme is that the tendon rope driven underwater dexterous hand is provided. Which comprises a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger, and is characterized in that the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger comprise far knuckles, middle knuckles and near knuckles and simulate human knuckles; the thumb comprises near knuckles and far knuckles and simulates knuckles of human beings; the palm simulates the shape of a human palm and is respectively connected with the near knuckles of the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger. The self-adaptive grabbing device is suitable for being applied to efficient and lossless self-adaptive grabbing work of underwater organisms through a mechanical arm.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Marine surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle device
abstract: The invention provides a marine surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle device, and relates to the technical field of surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicles. The marine surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle device comprises a machine shell, a fixing block is fixedly connected to one side of the machine shell, a fixing cover is fixedly connected to one side of the fixing block, an arc-shaped plate is fixedly connected to one side of the fixing cover, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the machine shell, and a protective cover is fixedly connected to one side of the mounting plate. title: Method for calculating wave-making resistance of underwater robot based on FPGA
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater robots, and discloses a method for calculating wave-making resistance of an underwater robot based on an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array), which comprises the following steps: (1) compiling a dat file in a user-defined manner; (2) analyzing the principle of the algorithm by applying a surface element method, and dividing main calculation modules of the algorithm; and (3) realizing each module by utilizing a high-level language C/C + +, importing a dat file customized and compiled by a user, and verifying the correctness of an algorithm function. And (4) converting a high-level language into an RTL (Real Time Language) by using a high-level synthesis tool HLS by taking the surface element method program of which the function is verified to be correct in the step (2) as an input file. And (5) generating the generated RTL code into an IP core, making the IP core into a bit stream file, and downloading and configuring the bit stream file to a configurable logic part of the FPGA. And (6) after FPGA operation is completed, the wave-making resistance coefficient of the underwater robot can be obtained. title: A SYSTEM TO QUANTIFY AND VISUALIZE VENTRICULAR ROTATION PATTERN OF THE HEART
abstract: Different modalities have been used to describe the rotational motion of the ventricles of the heart and studies have indicated LV twist to be an additional integral component in LV function. So far, only amplitudes and timings of rotation have been reported, whereas no method is available to fully describe the rotation pattern of the ventricles. The object of the present application is to achieve a system that presents a novel way to quantify and visualize the ventricular rotation pattern of the heart. We present a novel method that assesses and describes the rotation pattern by calculating the rotation axis of the ventricle. Non- invasive image acquisition is required to collect rotation values from different positions of the myocardium. Thereafter, a kinematic model of a ventricle is constructed to determine the rotation planes at different levels of the heart. The motion of the rotation planes are visualized by plotting the normal vectors of the planes over time, i.e. the rotation axis of the planes. This new method is different to all other methods used today for assessing cardiac function, as it does not describe the amplitude of a motion but the relationship in motion between different parts within a ventricle. Preliminary results indicate that the rotation axis is more sensitive to changes in the rotation pattern than conventional measurements of ventricular rotation. This new method could be used for early detection of cardiac diseases and for selection of patients for and optimization of cardiac resynchronization therapy.

abstract: 제1 에지영역 및 제2 에지영역에서의 듀티비를 중앙영역에서의 듀티비보다 크게 함으로써 저음속영역을 형성하는, 피스톤 모드를 이용한 탄성파 장치에서, 고차의 횡모드에 의한 스퓨리어스를 효과적으로 억제할 수 있는 탄성파 장치를 제공한다. 탄성파 장치(1)는 압전기판(2)(압전체)과, 압전기판(2) 상에 마련된 IDT 전극(3)을 포함한다. IDT 전극(3)에서는 중앙영역(A1), 제1, 제2 저음속영역 및 제1, 제2 고음속영역이 이 순서로 배치되어 있다. 복수개의 제1, 제2 전극지(3a2, 3b2)의 제1, 제2 저음속영역에서의 듀티비가 중앙영역(A1)에서의 듀티비보다 크다. 주전극층의 주성분인 금속 중을 전파하는 횡파 벌크파의 음속을 v(m/s)로 했을 때에 v≤3299m/s이고, IDT 전극(3)의 전극지 피치에 의해 규정되는 파장을 λ로 하며, 파장(λ)에 의해 규격화된 주전극층의 막두께를 T로 했을 때에, T≥0.00018e0.002V+0.014를 만족시킨다.

title: DISTANCE MEASURING DEVICE, DISTANCE MEASUREMENT METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: A technology of the present invention relates to a distance measurement device, a distance measurement method, and a program that enable the distance to a target to be accurately measured. A distance measurement device according to one aspect of the technology of the present invention comprises: an OFDM modulation unit that generates an OFDM signal by performing OFDM modulation on a transmission signal; an output unit that outputs the OFDM signal using an ultrasonic wave as a carrier wave; a sound collecting unit that collects, as a reception signal, ultrasonic waves that are reflected waves resulting from the ultrasonic waves output from the output unit being reflected by a target; a demodulation unit that generates a demodulated signal by demodulating the reception signal; a calculation unit that calculates a delay profile on the basis of an own signal obtained in the process of generating the OFDM signal and the demodulated signal; and an arithmetic unit that obtains a delay time of the ultrasonic waves from the delay profile and calculates the distance to the target on the basis of the delay time. The technology of the present invention can be applied to an automobile, for example.

title: An underwater acoustic sparse channel estimation variable step sparsity adaptive match tracking method
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic sparse channel estimation variable step sparsity adaptive matching tracking method, which fully utilizes the underwater acoustic channel sparse multipathcharacteristic and avoids the waste of frequency spectrum resources caused by the excessive number of pilots in the traditional channel estimation technology. The method does not need sparseness as apriori information, and the size of the support set is the estimated sparseness at the end of iteration by expanding the support set through step size. In addition, the signal reconstruction processis divided into several stages by combining stage idea and variable step size, the number of atoms in the support set in a certain phase remains constant, and the adjacent phases gradually expand thesupport set by different step sizes. The invention improves the recovery accuracy on the premise of not significantly increasing the calculation amount, that is, obtains a better trade-off between thereconstruction accuracy and the calculation complexity. Compared with the prior classical greedy algorithm, the invention does not need sparseness as a prior information, and the step size adaptive change can give consideration to the algorithm accuracy and the operation efficiency.

title: Sound wave communication method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention discloses a sound wave communication method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out channel coding on a first digital signal to obtain a coded second digital signal; inserting a code element synchronization head into the second digital signal to obtain a third digital signal; performing multi-system modulation on the third digital signal by using a plurality of sound wave frequency points corresponding to the target sound wave frequency band to obtain a modulated sound wave modulation signal; inserting a framesynchronization head in front of the sound wave modulation signal to obtain a to-be-transmitted sound wave signal; and transmitting the acoustic wave signal by using the first baseband frequency. According to the invention, the technical problem of low voice signal receiving accuracy caused by signal attenuation in the prior art is solved.

title: Target acoustic imaging and velocity measurement method and system based on pulse pair emission
abstract: The invention provides a target acoustic imaging and velocity measurement method and system based on pulse pair emission. The method comprises the following steps: applying pulse pair signals producedby a signal generator on an emission energy converter through a power amplifier, and radiating acoustic wave to a medium; receiving echo signals formed by the radiation acoustic wave through target scattering in the medium through all array elements of a receiving energy converter array, and converting signals of all array element receiving channels into digital signals through multi-channel signal collection; performing delay superposition processing on receiving channel digital signals through the digital signal processor, accomplishing the computation on all scanning beams to obtain the beamforming result; and according to the beamforming result, obtaining radial speed estimation of the target per-pixel, extracting time domain signal envelope of the beam, and accomplishing the computation of the scanning beam to obtain a scanned acoustic image. The speed estimation is performed on the pixels including point target when the acoustic imaging is realized, thereby acquiring the radialspeed estimation of all targets in the dielectric.

title: Printer for Providing Mobile Payment Based on Sound Wave
abstract: According to the present invention, a printing device with a printing module capable of printing a receipt requested to be printed from a payment terminal comprises: a communication unit which processes communication with the payment terminal in a designated communication method to process printing; a sound wave output unit which outputs a sound wave signal in a predetermined sound wave frequency band; and a control module. The control module includes: a data receiving unit for receiving a data set transmitted from the payment terminal through the communication unit; a data reading unit which reads the received data set and reads whether the read data set contains cash payment receipt information; a data processing unit which interrupts the data set so that the data set is not printed through the printing module when the data set contains the cash payment receipt information, or stores and manages the data set in a predetermined storage area; and a sound wave transmitting unit which processes the sound wave signal, obtained by encoding of encoding information including payment request information including the data set (or information extracted from the data set), to be output at predetermined signal intensity through the sound wave output unit when the data set is interrupted or stored. title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR FLASH SUPPRESSION IN ULTRASOUND IMAGING
abstract: The invention provides a system and method for flash suppression in ultrasound imaging. Methods and systems are provided for color flow ultrasound imaging. In one embodiment, a method comprises acquiring color flow data, detecting, with a neural network, a flash artifact in the color flow data, adjusting an adaptive filter cutoff of a clutter filter based on a classification result of the neural network, filtering, with the clutter filter, the flash artifact from the color flow data, and displaying a color flow image generated from the filtered color flow data. In this way, strong flash artifacts caused by strong tissue movement or probe movement may be dynamically suppressed during color flow ultrasound imaging.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR OPERATION OF MULTIAXIAL ULTRASOUND TRANSDUCERS
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for performing ultrasound imaging using biphasic driving and/or reception for ferroelectric ultrasound elements having propagation and lateral electrode pairs. Electrode pairs are driven using biphasic drive signals, where the drive signals applied to the respective pairs of electrodes are provided with a phase difference therebetween, and where a time delay may be added between the drive signals to further increase the power of the emitted ultrasound. In some example embodiments, passive determination of the direction and/or location of an acoustic source relative to a multiaxial ultrasound transducer is determined based on the voltages detected at the propagation electrodes and the lateral electrodes the multiaxial transducer, according to a pre-determined relationship between the electrode voltages and one or more directional angles. A plurality of multiaxial ultrasound transducers may be employed to improve the accuracy of the estimated direction and/or location of the acoustic source.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR RIVERBED MONITORING USING A FIBER OPTIC CABLE SENSOR
abstract: This specification describes a sensing device that is permanently installed in a riverbed to monitor sediment scour and deposition levels to provide information regarding hazards to infrastructure or ecological systems. The sensor is oblong and composed of fiber optic cables and other materials such that the sensor body is held orthogonal to the riverbed/river water interface and can be interrogated continuously or periodically to provide information on the spatial position of the riverbed/river water interface. The sensor is more accurate than existing options because it simultaneously senses the physical condition of fiber optic cable where it is buried in static sediment, and where it is exposed to moving river water. Intrinsic interrogative sensing is performed on the fiber optic cable or cables for strain, temperature, or acoustic vibration conditions, or combinations thereof. Methods for fabrication, installation, and use of the sensor are also described and claimed.

title: Underwater manta ray imitating robot
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater manta ray imitating robot. The robot comprises a head assembly, a trunk assembly, symmetrical left and right pectoral fin assemblies, an anal fin assembly, a tail handle, a dorsal fin assembly and a buoyancy adjusting assembly. The single-side pectoral fin assembly is driven by nine joint motors in series, multi-degree-of-freedom swing of pectoral fins in the spanwise direction and the chordwise direction is achieved according to the spanwise-chordwise alternating arrangement sequence, and the swimming flexibility and the bionic similarity are remarkably improved; five groups of elastic plates are arranged at the front and rear edges of the pectoral fins and are connected through flexible cloth to form a rigid-flexible combined structure, and the stability and motion consistency at high speed are considered; four buoyancy adjusting devices are symmetrically arranged on the periphery of the trunk, and pitching, floating or diving of the robot is achieved through displacement control. The anal fin assembly provides auxiliary propulsive force, and the overall maneuverability is enhanced. In addition, a front/lower vision module, sonar and a wireless communication module are integrated, and autonomous cruise and remote control are supported. The manta ray imitating robot solves the problems of insufficient degree of freedom of pectoral fins and low propelling efficiency of an existing manta ray imitating robot, can be applied to the fields of ocean exploration, ecological monitoring, underwater entertainment and the like, and has the advantages of high efficiency, high bionic degree and multifunctional integration.

title: RECURSIVE OBJECT DETECTION FILTER
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for detecting and tracking objects. A first set of observations for a plurality of locations includes a probability that a value associated with the location is consistent with local background. A second set of observations includes a probability that the value associated with the location is not consistent with local background. A first probability tensor representing probabilities for each of a plurality of states for each of the plurality of locations is generated from the first and second sets of observations. The first probability tensor is updated according to a second probability tensor representing the probabilities for each of the plurality of states in a previous time step. It is determined that a target is present in the region of interest when a posterior probability meets a threshold value.

title: Joint defense and joint control zoning method for water environment risks across administrative regions
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of environment monitoring, in particular to a cross-administrative region water environment risk joint defense and joint control zoning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a section parameter change direction, screening sections with consistent trend, extracting a cross-regional water body connection relationship, identifying path continuity, judging a boundary connection state, and identifying water area coverage consistency. And screening a section arrangement offset area, and delimiting a joint defense partition structure table. According to the method, section response feature extraction is enhanced through multi-parameter trend consistency screening, a path construction standard is established in combination with water body flow direction and access continuity, structural integrity of spatial connection and hydrodynamic force conduction rationality are enhanced, and water surface coverage continuity and section distribution coordination judgment are introduced into a boundary area. A cross-regional water area range delimitation basis is refined, partition reconstruction is completed according to a water flow connection sequence, a joint prevention and joint control partition structure with a coordinated coverage range and consistent water area boundary scale and trend pointing is constructed, and ordered operation of a cross-regional pollution treatment cooperation mechanism is promoted.

abstract: The invention relates to an underwater three-dimensional real scene real-time imaging system. The system has a bright application prospect in aspects such as dam underwater part monitoring, harbor wall inspection, underwater engineering implementation, submarine pipeline inspection, obstacle avoidance and navigation of underwater vehicles.

title: WATER BODY MONITORING AND/OR AUTOMATIC CONTROL THROUGH A HIGH-PRECISION SENSOR BUOY
abstract: A water level monitoring system includes a sensor buoy with a GPS unit and RTK correction system for high-precision elevation measurements in bodies of water. The sensor buoy is easily deployable in existing facilities and can be used to survey bodies of water during site setup. The sensor buoy includes a float, geospatial positioning unit, wireless network interface, and/or power source such as a solar array. A coordination server may receive geospatial coordinates from the sensor buoy including elevation data and use site-specific depth and volume functions to calculate water levels. Automated alerts may be generated when water levels exceed thresholds and/or control infrastructure devices such as valves and pumps to prevent overflow conditions and improve operational efficiency. The sensor buoy may operates autonomously with adaptive data resolution, accuracy, and/or precision adjustment based on water level conditions and power management needs. title: Underwater vehicle obstacle avoidance method and system, medium and product

title: Underwater tunnel detection device

title: Multi-joint submersible for deep sea detection
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-joint submersible for deep sea detection. The multi-joint submersible comprises a flow guiding cabin, a control cabin, a propelling cabin, a propeller and tail rudders, wherein the flow guiding cabin is connected with the control cabin through a two-degree-of-freedom joint; the control cabin and the propelling cabin are connected through another two-degree-of-freedom joint; the propeller is fixedly connected to the rear part of the propelling cabin; the tail rudders are uniformly distributed on the rear part of the propelling cabin around the axis; the controlcabin is a dry cabin part of the submersible, a pressure-resistant design is adopted, and two slideways are symmetrically distributed on the two sides inside the control cabin; the control cabin comprise a control cabin shell, batteries, a power supply, an iridium satellite communication module, a GPS communication module, a central controller and two gyroscopes, and a motor and a driver which arefor driving the two two-degree-of-freedom joints are arranged in the control cabin; the batteries are fixed to the slideways in the control cabin shell; and angle information of the two two-degree-of-freedom joints detected by the two gyroscopes is transmitted to the central controller, and the iridium satellite communication module and the GPS communication module are connected with the centralcontroller.
note: multi-joint deep-sea submersible; crew not stated

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR UTILITY POWER LINES VEGETATION PROXIMITY MONITORING AND CONTROLLING
abstract: Systems and methods for utility infrastructure condition monitoring, detection, and response are disclosed. One exemplary system includes a node and a detection circuit and control circuit. The node includes a sensor configured to capture data indicative of one or more conditions (e.g., an environmental condition, a structural condition, etc.) in the vicinity of the utility infrastructure. The monitoring and control includes a detection circuit and a control or an alert circuit. The detection circuit is configured to receive data captured by each sensor and, based on the captured data, determine one or more conditions in the vicinity of the utility infrastructure. The detection module may be configured to then, based on the determined conditions, an unmanned aerial system (UAS) or watercraft to be dispatched using the control circuit, or provide an alert for the condition using the alert circuit.
note: no underwater drone

title: An intelligent floating drainage pipeline inspection system
abstract: This invention belongs to the field of urban drainage pipeline inspection technology and discloses an intelligent floating drainage pipeline inspection system. It includes a detection device body and floating wings located on the left and right sides of the detection device body. The detection device body comprises a shell and a power supply unit, autonomous navigation unit, control unit, and obstacle avoidance unit located inside the shell. The drive unit is installed at the rear of the shell, the camera unit is installed above the shell. The drive unit, power supply unit, camera unit, autonomous navigation unit, and obstacle avoidance unit are all electrically connected to the control unit. The cloud processing unit consists of sequentially connected data analysis modules and detection report generation modules. The data analysis module is connected to the control unit for communication. The user terminal is connected to the detection report generation module for communication.
note: floating drainage-pipe inspector

title: Systems and methods for multi-mode unmanned vehicle mission planning and control
abstract: Systems and associated methods for planning and control of a fleet of unmanned vehicles in missions that are coordinated temporally and spatially by geo-location, direction, vehicle orientation, altitude above sea level, and depth below sea level. The unmanned vehicles' transit routes may be fully autonomous, semi-autonomous, or under direct operator control using off board control systems. Means are provided for intervention and transit changes during mission execution. Means are provided to collect, centralize and analyze mission data collected on the set of participating unmanned vehicles.

title: DEVICE FOR EXTERNAL FLAW DETECTION OF UNDERWATER VERTICAL HYDRAULIC STRUCTURES
abstract: FIELD: underwater equipment.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to underwater equipment used for maintenance and periodic inspection of underwater parts of hydraulic engineering infrastructure, namely to remote-controlled underwater robotic systems providing high-accuracy examination, including using non-destructive testing methods, profiling of underwater extended, mainly vertically located surfaces of objects. Device for external flaw detection of underwater vertical hydraulic structures, comprising a serial rope connection of anchor, movable carrier and floating buoy, creating a rope line. At that, anchor and floating buoy are arranged on ends of rope line, and floating buoy is equipped with control unit, storage battery, matched pair of horizontal propellers, a global satellite positioning system navigation module and a Wi-Fi antenna for transmitting hydroacoustic information to an operator and receiving control commands therefrom. Accumulator battery, the navigation module of the global satellite positioning system and the Wi-Fi antenna are connected to the inputs of the control unit, and the pair of horizontal buoy movers is connected to outputs of the control unit. Movable carrier is installed on rope with possibility of movement along rope line and is equipped with sonar with switched operating frequency, central control computer, inertial measuring system, vertical propulsor for vertical movement of movable carrier and matched pair of horizontal propellers intended for angular orientation of movable carrier around vertical axis of rope line. Central control computer is configured to receive commands from the control unit via the multi-wire submarine cable and generate control commands through the electrically connected vertical propulsor, matched pair of movable carrier movers, inertial measurement system and sonar with switched operating frequency, which is also connected through multi-wire submarine cable with control unit and Wi-Fi antenna.EFFECT: technical result of the proposed invention consists in expansion of the range of technical means intended for external flaw detection of underwater vertical hydraulic structures with high image detail when shooting at depth, as well as possibility of more accurate image binding to object.1 cl, 4 dwg

title: Deep-sea mobile operation device with replaceable toolkit and replacement method of deep-sea mobile operation device
abstract: The invention discloses a deep sea mobile operation device capable of replacing toolkits and a replacement method thereof, the device comprises a toolkit module, a mobile control module and a locking mechanism, the toolkit module comprises at least two independent toolkits; the toolkit is provided with a sampling device, and the toolkit performs underwater sampling through the sampling device; the mobile control module is detachably connected with the toolkit through the locking mechanism; the movement control module comprises a driving device, and the movement control module provides driving force through the driving device and can drive the tool bag to accurately move underwater. The method is carried out by the device. Through locking combination of the mobile control module and different toolkits, the toolkits can be replaced, the resource cost of operation is saved, and the operation efficiency is improved. Furthermore, the movement control module is provided with a driving device, accurate movement positioning can be carried out, autonomous operation is achieved, and the underwater operation efficiency and the operation quality are improved.

title: Water area heterogeneous multi-unmanned-vehicle consistent formation method
abstract: The invention provides a water area heterogeneous multi-unmanned-vehicle consistent formation method. The method aims at solving the problem of model heterogeneity of unmanned aerial vehicles in different environments, such as the problem of environment difference of unmanned aerial vehicles, unmanned ships and underwater vehicles in a water area environment. Consistency control laws of three heterogeneous models are respectively designed by considering environmental parameters and differences of different motion space dimensions, the design process of the consistency algorithm is re-deduced, the stability is proved through block Kronecker product and matrix transformation, and some sufficient conditions for parameter selection are given. According to the invention, the optimization problem and the obstacle avoidance problem in the forming process are considered, different areas such as a circle and a peak threat model are introduced for the obstacle avoidance model problem in an actual water area, and different potential function expressions are constructed. Then the heterogeneous multi-agent system is converted into a closed-loop error system, formation control, an obstacle avoidance optimization function and an index function are defined, and a consistent non-quadratic obstacle avoidance optimal control strategy is deduced by adopting an inverse optimal control algorithm.

title: UNDERWATER DISTURBANCE GENERATOR
abstract: The present invention relates to an underwater disturbance generation device capable of verifying posture maintenance performance for accurate mission performance in an underwater environment with many disturbances such as waves and currents. The present invention comprises: a pressure-resistant container equipped with a control part inside; at least one propulsion part provided on one side of the pressure-resistant container and generating power; a bending part provided on the other side of the pressure-resistant container and coupled to a subject; and a weight adjustment part provided in the pressure-resistant container and allowing the weight to be adjusted.
note: disturbance generator to test underwater vehicles

title: Cable-controlled observation and maintenance robot with convertible underwater motion state
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, in particular to a cable-controlled observation and maintenance robot with a convertible underwater motion state. A water surface control unit is communicated with an underwater robot unit through a fine optical fiber; the underwater robot unit comprises a main body frame, a buoyancy material shell is mounted on the main body frame, a mounting cavity is formed between the main body frame and the buoyancy material shell, and a control/navigation equipment cabin and a control energy source power cabin are mounted in the mounting cavity; the composite wheel position conversion devices are installed at the four corners of the main body frame, the propeller composite wheels are installed on the composite wheel position conversion devices respectively and used for providing power for the robot, and switching of the underwater floating state, the crawling state or the walking state of the robot is achieved. By adjusting the buoyancy state and the position of the propeller composite wheel, switching of the floating state, the crawling function and the walking function of the underwater robot unit is rapidly completed, the underwater robot unit adapts to the complex underwater operation environment, then underwater observation and maintenance operation are completed, and the environment adaptability is high.

title: Apparatus for monitoring and observing offshore with flight vehicle and underwater vehicle
abstract: The present invention relates to an aerial/marine complex moving body for monitoring and observing a coast, comprising: a control system; an unmanned marine moving body which moves to a target position in accordance with control of the control system; an unmanned flying body which is able to take off from or land on the unmanned marine moving body and to monitor a coastal area; a connection system which connects the unmanned flying body to the unmanned marine moving body; and a collaboration control module which is able to, while the unmanned flying body works, provide a target position signal for notifying the target position to which the unmanned flying body and the unmanned marine moving body need to move based on the position information of the unmanned flying body. In accordance with the target position signal of the collaboration control module, the unmanned flying body and the unmanned marine moving body move within a pre-designated work area and observe the coastal area. The present invention aims to provide the aerial/marine complex moving body for monitoring and observing a coast, which is able to connect an unmanned flying body and an unmanned marine moving body to monitor and observe a coastal area.

title: Real-time obstacle detection and avoidance method and device for underwater vehicle based on foresight sonar
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an underwater vehicle real-time obstacle detection and avoidance method and device based on a foresight sonar, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a foresight sonar image in real time, and extracting key obstacle information from the foresight sonar image; establishing an obstacle situation map based on the extracted key obstacle information, and establishing a global situation map; and integrating the obstacle situation map and the global situation map to perform real-time obstacle avoidance and route dynamic planning of the underwater vehicle. The embodiment of the invention can be used for the underwater vehicle to realize autonomous obstacle recognition and avoidance, so that the underwater vehicle can autonomously execute tasks in a complex and unknown water environment.
