title: Underwater unknown environment active mapping method based on hovering type underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater unknown environment active mapping method based on a hovering type underwater vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of robot environment exploration. According to the underwater unknown environment active mapping method based on the hovering type underwater vehicle provided by the invention, the hovering type underwater vehicle is matched with the sensor to obtain the environment data of the ocean unknown area, and the optimal next viewpoint is determined according to the information gain value; and determining a safe and feasible path to the optimal next viewpoint according to the cost of the optimal next viewpoint when each adjacent node on the current tree is used as a father node. In this way, the grid map is updated in real time, construction and dynamic updating of the map are efficiently, rapidly and accurately achieved, then the underwater vehicle is assisted to achieve navigation of the target area, and the method has wide application prospects in underwater environment exploration tasks, underwater structure inspection and other similar tasks based on the underwater vehicle.

title: Buoyancy control module for field configurable autonomous vehicle
abstract: A field configurable autonomous vehicle includes modular elements and attachable components. The vehicle can be assembled from these modular elements and components to meet desired mission and performance characteristics without the need to purchase specially designed vehicles for each mission. The vehicle can include a module for buoyancy control.
note: field-configurable autonomous underwater vehicle

title: Underwater route planning method and device based on electronic chart
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater route planning method and device based on an electronic chart. According to the method, underwater route planning is carried out based on the electronic chart, marine environment elements are fully considered, route planning point positions with timestamps can be given, the course, the voyage and the navigational speed of each subsection route can be calculated, and the method has important guiding significance for operation and control of the underwater vehicle. According to the method, the given task can be efficiently completed with low cost, and the method can be applied and popularized in the field of underwater navigation safety.

title: UNDERWATER VEHICLE FLOATING POSITION SELECTION METHOD AND UNDERWATER VEHICLE FLOATING POSITION SELECTION DEVICE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make it possible for an underwater vehicle itself to select a floating position without obstacles.SOLUTION: An underwater vehicle 1 comprises a floating-position selector 8 that includes a floating position controller 9 and a planned-floating-position-setting storage unit 10. In a case of floating the underwater vehicle 1, the floating position controller 9 calls position information on a planned floating position 11 from the planned-floating-position-setting storage unit 10, and controls a sonar 7 of the underwater vehicle 1 to scan the planned floating position 11 and a peripheral region 12 of the planned floating position 11. On the basis of a result of scanning, water level depths of the planned floating position 11 and the peripheral region 12 are averaged in time and plane space, and the planned floating position 11 is selected as an actual floating position if averages of the water level depths of the planned floating position 11 and the peripheral region 12 are not positive and the average of the water level depth of the planned floating position 11 is not closer to a positive depth than the average of the water level depth of the peripheral region 12.

title: Long-baseline positioning system seabed transponder sea surface position indicating device
abstract: The invention relates to positioning devices of underwater robot accessory equipment, particularly to a long-baseline positioning system seabed transponder sea surface position indicating device. The long-baseline positioning system seabed transponder sea surface position indicating device comprises a floating ball, a main cabin, a pressure compensator, a pressure switch and a charging/debugging interface, wherein the main cabin, the pressure compensator and the pressure switch are arranged in sequentially-communicated different cavities inside the floating ball respectively; the pressure compensator and the pressure switch are mounted on both sides of the main cabin; the charging/debugging interface is arranged inside an inclined hole communicated with the cavity of the main cabin; the main cabin, the pressure compensator, the pressure switch and the charging/debugging interface are connected through oil tubes; circuit wires are arranged inside the oil tubes; the inside of the main cabin is provided with a master control unit and a battery pack; the outside of the floating ball is provided with an antenna matched with the master control unit, and a strobe light. The long-baseline positioning system seabed transponder sea surface position indicating device can transmit the position information of a long-baseline seabed transponder emerging from water to a mother ship and facilitates location and recovery of the long-baseline seabed transponder.

title: Underwater detection robot and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater detection robots, and relates to an underwater detection robot and a detection method thereof. The underwater detection robot comprises a first bin body, a second bin body, a third bin body and a fourth bin body which are sequentially connected in series in the axial direction through flexible connecting pieces, a first camera, a pitching adjuster and a transverse adjuster are arranged on the first bin body, and a main propeller and a floating and sinking adjuster are arranged on the second bin body. A hydrophone and a control module are arranged on the third bin body; a second camera is arranged on the fourth bin body, and the rear end of the fourth bin body is used for being connected with external equipment through a communication cable. The underwater detection robot is formed by flexibly connecting the four functional bins in series, can adapt to various shape changes of underwater pipelines, can flexibly turn and move, and can efficiently and reliably achieve underwater detection.

title: Underwater vehicle automatic hovering control system and control method based on water injection and drainage
abstract: The invention provides an underwater vehicle automatic hovering control system and control method based on water injection and drainage. The water injection and drainage instruction is automatically calculated and generated in real time according to the real-time depth, the hovering target depth and the depth change rate of the underwater vehicle, and automatic hovering of the underwater vehicle based on water injection and drainage is achieved. The method is suitable for the underwater vehicle with the water injection and drainage capacity, water injection and drainage can be automatically controlled under the condition of a certain initial unbalance amount, automatic hovering of the underwater vehicle is implemented, and the requirement of the underwater vehicle for automatic depth keeping is met. Under the conditions of 300L initial unbalance and uniform density layer, the automatic hovering of the underwater vehicle with the depth stability precision of +/-5m is realized. The method does not need to depend on the control experience of an operator, and the hovering control precision is stable and reliable.

title: Multi-mode adaptive control method and system for underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater vehicles, in particular to a multi-mode adaptive control method and system for an underwater vehicle, and the system comprises a monitoring module which is used for monitoring the real-time navigation path of the underwater vehicle; the drawing module is used for receiving the real-time navigation path of the underwater vehicle monitored by the monitoring module, and drawing a navigation path model of the underwater vehicle by using the real-time navigation path of the underwater vehicle; and the control module is used for sensing whether the underwater vehicle arrives at the boundary of the activity area or not and generating turn-back parameters when the underwater vehicle arrives at the boundary of the activity area. Full-intelligent navigation path planning is provided for the underwater vehicle through construction of the navigation path model of the underwater vehicle; the marine environment parameter acquisition logic of the underwater vehicle in the navigation process is synchronously designed, so that the underwater vehicle can run in a self-adaptive multi-mode navigation and acquisition logic manner, the intelligent degree of the underwater vehicle is effectively improved, and the labor cost of underwater vehicle management is reduced.

title: On-board underwater target detection device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an on-board underwater target detection device, and relates to the technical field of underwater detection. According to the marine underwater target detection device, a signal transmitter is arranged at the top of a flow guide shell, a first motor is fixed to a battery compartment, a first bevel gear set is installed on the first motor, a driving rod is installed on the first bevel gear set, a propeller is fixed to a base, and a second bevel gear set is installed on the driving rod. The detection part is arranged in the flow guide shell, the stabilizing mechanism penetrates through the protection mechanism, the adjusting mechanism is arranged in the protection mechanism, an underwater target is detected through a detection assembly, diving and floating actions are completed through a first driving part, a signal is sent to a worker on a ship body through a signal transmitter, and then the worker on the ship body is driven to go through the stabilizing mechanism. The device is positioned and tracked, interference of the umbilical cable on the device in water is avoided, the device can dive to a deeper sea area, and the detection capacity of the device is improved.

title: Distributed underwater full-automatic intelligent acquisition system
abstract: The invention relates to the field of underwater robot collection. The invention aims to provide a distributed underwater full-automatic intelligent acquisition system capable of meeting deep sea acquisition requirements. According to the technical scheme, the distributed underwater full-automatic intelligent acquisition system is characterized by comprising a base station and at least a pluralityof acquisition vehicles, the base station is provided with a signal transmitting tower, a base station charging port, a material collecting mechanism and a power supply; and each acquisition vehicleis provided with a power mechanism, a crawler belt mechanism, a collecting vehicle charging port, a camera, a collecting claw, a battery, a communication module, a collecting hopper and a collecting vehicle charging port.

title: DRONE AND ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract: A system may be configured to manage at least one robotic device. The system may comprise one or more databases and one or more processors in communication with the one or more databases. The one or more processors may be configured to provide an operating system for the at least one robotic device, control motion of the at least one robotic device, configure at least one sensor removably coupled to the at least one robotic device, process data collected by the at least one sensor, and/or perform localization and/or area mapping for the at least one robotic device by comparing data collected by the at least one sensor with data in the one or more databases to generate localization and/or area mapping data.
note: generic robot control

title: Obstacle avoidance control method and system suitable for two-dimensional unknown complex water area environment
abstract: The invention discloses an obstacle avoidance control method and system suitable for a two-dimensional unknown complex water area environment, and relates to the field of autonomous navigation and real-time obstacle avoidance control of underwater robots, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the morphological closed operation processing of an original non-convex obstacle, generating a smooth boundary with a unique nearest projection point, and constructing a flow set and a jump set; a dynamic virtual ring is constructed with the current position of the underwater robot as the center, the radius of the dynamic virtual ring is dynamically calculated according to the distance between the underwater robot and the obstacle, and the unique projection point of the underwater robot on the obstacle is obtained; according to the state switching conditions of the flow set and the jump set, the current mode of the underwater robot is judged, mode switching is carried out according to the hybrid control law, and a corresponding speed vector is calculated; and updating the pose of the underwater robot until the underwater robot reaches the target point. According to the method, non-convex obstacles can be effectively processed under the condition of no global map, and smooth switching between modes and global stability guarantee are realized.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Miniature underwater unmanned vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a miniature underwater unmanned vehicle, which relates to the technical field of underwater navigation equipment and comprises a shell, a sensing assembly, a communication assembly, a power assembly, a main control component and a power supply assembly, the shell is in a streamline closed shape, and a detection cabin, a control cabin, a power supply cabin and an equipment cabin are sequentially arranged in the shell from front to back. The sensing assembly is used for acquiring environment information and attitude information; the communication assembly is used for positioning and can be in communication connection with the outside; the power assembly is used for providing power and can perform attitude control; the main control component is arranged in the control cabin, and the main control component can receive the environment information and the attitude information; the main control component is also in communication connection with the communication component and can be in communication connection with the outside; the main control component can also control the action of the power assembly; and the power supply assembly can provide required electric energy. According to the miniature underwater unmanned vehicle provided by the invention, the task flexibility and the rationality of spatial arrangement are improved.

title: System and method for deep sea navigation and positioning based on long baseline or ultra-short baseline networking
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for deep sea navigation and positioning based on long baseline or ultra-short baseline networking. The system comprises: a lattice measuring sonar arranged at an underwater robot or an underwater vehicle, a sound velocity profiler arranged at the underwater robot or the underwater vehicle and lattice measuring network points distributed at a sea area; and the lattice measuring sonar and the sound velocity profiler are configured to obtain distance between the underwater robot or the underwater vehicle and a subsea survey lattice point responder, orientation of the underwater robot or the underwater vehicle and a sound velocity profile of the current sea area, analyze and calculate accurate position of the underwater robot or the underwater vehicle and take the place of water surface GPS positioning or active calibration. The system and the method provided by the invention are good in concealment and redundancy, can realize underwater positioning and navigation of an underwater robot or an underwater vehicle, have broad prospects for military applications in future, will provide great help to China's coastal defense industry andprovide an effective positioning means for marine development and utilization.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: The invention discloses a bBuoyancy regulation low-power-consumption control method based on a genetic algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a buoyancy regulation low-power-consumption control method based on a genetic algorithm. The invention discloses a low-power-consumption buoyancy adjusting method, belongings to the field of control of underwater robots, and aims to obtain a low-power-consumption buoyancy adjusting method by adopting a genetic algorithm to optimize and select the buoyancy adjusting processof detection equipment, avoid the problem of high energy consumption caused by motor work in a high-pressure environment, effectively save energy and prolong the working time of the underwater detection equipment. Meanwhile, according to the method, a motion model of underwater detection equipment is considered; T; the corresponding buoyancy adjusting method can be flexibly adjusted by selecting the power consumption weight and the time weight to adapt to different detection tasks, so that the problem that the motion time of the detection equipment is ignored by only considering the power consumption is avoided, and an experimenter can grasp the overall motion time of the underwater detection equipment favorably.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater barricade avoiding method and system
abstract: The invention provides an underwater barricade avoiding method and system, and relates to the technical field of underwater robots. The method comprises that an underwater robot determines present position information, and sends a geographical module request with the position information to a service end; the underwater robot generates an avoidance strategy according to obtained one or multiple geographical module(s); and according to the travel direction and real-time position information, the underwater robot determines threshold information that is satisfied at present, and adopts an avoidance motion corresponding to the threshold information. According to the method and system, barricades are pre-determined on the basis of the geographical modules, and the avoidance motions are executed according to determination. A working marine site is divided into multiple geographical modules according to sensing and detecting features of the underwater robot, a working area corresponding to a preset task can be determined, the corresponding geographical modules are sent to the corresponding robot, the total data analysis amount of the underwater robot is reduced, and the response speed and working security of the underwater robot are improved.

title: Underwater rescue submersible vehicle navigation docking control system adopting negative pressure adsorption
abstract: The invention provides an underwater rescue submersible vehicle navigation docking control system adopting negative pressure adsorption, which comprises an underwater information collection subsystem, an information processing decision subsystem and a docking execution subsystem, wherein the underwater information collection subsystem comprises an underwater camera monitoring device, an acoustic communication device, a physical environment detection device, a rescue target recognition device, a docking state indication device and an information processing device, and is used for underwater illumination, collection of external information and collection and centralized storage of information measured by a sensor; the information processing decision subsystem comprises a data fusion processing module, a task planning and execution module, an intelligent decision support module, a risk assessment and emergency response module, an operator interface and interaction module and a submersible vehicle control system interface module, and is used for processing and analyzing information and making a decision; and the docking execution subsystem is used for receiving the instruction sent by the information processing decision subsystem and completing docking on the surface of the wrecked ship through negative pressure adsorption.
note: rescue submersible docking; crew not stated

title: Underwater section monitoring robot controller and automatic trajectory tracking controlling method
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater section monitoring robot controller which includes a controller A arranged in a ship-loaded control box and a controller B arranged in an underwater robot instrument cabinet. The two controllers communicate through an armored umbilical cable. The controller A acquires a remote-control control instruction of a control panel of the ship-loaded controller in a real-time manner and carries out coding and assembled framing on the control instruction according to a customer-defined communication protocol and then sends the control instruction to the underwater controller B via a communication module. The underwater controller B receives a protocol frame, which is sent by the ship-loaded controller A, in a real-time manner and carries out protocol decoding and analyzing out the control instruction according to a protocol format so as to control a switch of a corresponding relay on a relay driving plate to move and thus control of motion postures of the underwater robot is realized. The underwater section monitoring robot controller and the automatic trajectory tracking controlling method adopt a limited-time trajectory tracking control technology to realize tracking of a preset trajectory point by an underwater robot so that wide-range and high-precision motion and posture control of the underwater section monitoring robot can be realized.

abstract: FIELD: transport.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to remote control robotised measuring and actuating systems. Proposed system comprises underwater system composed of remote control carrier to be operated in two media and equipped with hold-down screw propellers to hold down said carrier in underwater operations. Said carrier allows accommodating, at least, one independent device composed of manipulation module, and/or inspection module, and/or working module.EFFECT: robotised operation, higher safety.14 cl

title: Multi-role unmanned vehicle system and associated methods
abstract: An unmanned vehicle may include a vehicle body that comprises an enclosed hull. The unmanned vehicle may include a propulsion, a ballast control system, a center of gravity system, a pressurization system, a control surface system, a navigation control system, and an on board master control system. The on board master control system may execute local control over operation of the various systems of the unmanned vehicle. The unmanned vehicle may also include a power supply carried by a portion of the vehicle body to provide power to the various systems. The various systems of the unmanned vehicle may be independently operable to support selective operation of the unmanned vehicle in the air, on the surface of the water, and below the surface of the water.

title: COMPACT MULTI-FUNCTIONAL AUTONOMOUS UNINHABITED UNDERWATER VEHICLE -CARRIER VEHICLE FOR REPLACEABLE ACTUAL LOAD
abstract: FIELD: vessels and other floating vehicles; equipment therefor.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to underwater technical means for research and development of the world's oceans. Compact multifunctional autonomous uninhabited underwater vehicle (AUUV), designed to perform a wide range of research, prospecting and underwater technical works on the shelf, is proposed. AUUV contains a hull supporting structure made of compartments, including from the aft sealed compartment and the adjacent hermetic compartment, consistently and rigidly interconnected with the possibility of their connector in the direction of the longitudinal axis of the AUUV, propulsion and steering complex of four sustainers and vertical thruster propulsion, the basic systems supporting the operation of the AUUV as part of the program control and navigation system, power supply systems based on the battery module, hydroacoustic communication system and radio communication system, buoyancy blocks. Marching propellers are installed in the tail section of the aft compartment on the stabilizers, and the vertical thruster is located in one of the compartments. Battery module is located in the aft compartment. Between the feed compartment and the adjacent hermetic compartment there is an intermediate hermetic compartment of a smaller outer diameter additionally rigidly installed. Structural elements of the basic systems ensuring the functioning of the AUUV are housed in an airtight compartment adjacent to the intermediate sealed compartment of a smaller outer diameter. AUUV is made of an immutable base part, including a propulsion and steering complex, battery module, basic systems, ensuring its functioning, and structurally and functionally related parts to accommodate a replaceable payload, which includes both a compartment that is permeable to seawater and a sealed compartment.EFFECT: technical result consists in expanding the functionality, improving the manufacturability, improving the maintenance of the AUUV.1 cl, 2 dwg

title: METHOD FOR SPATIAL ORIENTATION OF A MOBILE UNDERWATER OBJECT
abstract: FIELD: marine technology.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of marine technology, to methods of spatial orientation of moving objects, and can be used for navigation. Dead reckoning is performed using the onboard inertial navigation system, the current coordinates are specified. An information database of explored underwater landmarks is used. Data on the necessary underwater landmarks on the route are recorded in the storage device of the moving object at the stage of preparing it for launch simultaneously with the entry of the route of movement and the program of work. The location of the moving object on the route is specified if the accuracy of the landmark is higher than dead reckoning. If on the contrary, then the coordinates of the landmark are specified. When new stationary objects are detected, their characteristics are entered into the database for transmission to the control center and further use as underwater landmarks. They use such characteristics of underwater landmarks as their orientation in space, geometric dimensions and external appearance, by which they are recognized with the help of technical means of observation.EFFECT: high positioning accuracy is ensured. A database of fixed landmarks is being created.1 cl, 1 dwg

title: Underwater vehicle invisible path planning method based on transparency and spring layer data
abstract: The invention provides an underwater vehicle invisible path planning method based on transparency and spring layer data. The method comprises the following key steps of determining a navigation region; extracting and the transparency and the spring layer data; evaluating the navigation region on the basis of the transparency and the spring layer data; performing point processing on the discrete transparency and the spring layer data to form a polygonal region; searching the optimum path in the navigation region by using a particle swarm algorithm, and the like. The navigation region is dividedinto a prohibited area, a dangerous region, an invisible region and an exposure region according to the influence of the seawater transparency and the spring layer on an underwater vehicle; on the basis of the underwater vehicle safety and invisible performance design path evaluation function, the underwater vehicle navigation path is planned by using the particle swarm algorithm; the path meeting the safe and invisible navigation requirement of the underwater vehicle can be obtained.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater path planning method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater path planning method and system, and belongs to the technical field of path planning. The influence of water flow in the underwater environment is large, most of underwater obstacles are not static, and the movement of an underwater vehicle is influenced by the water flow while the underwater obstacles move along with the water flow, so that the factors are fully considered; a cost function for the underwater environment is designed by combining the kinematics characteristics of the underwater vehicle, the influence of water flow, the running speed and running time of the underwater vehicle and the like; when trajectory optimization is carried out, a safe, dynamic and feasible trajectory can be generated by adopting a BSpline algorithm in combination with the speed of water flow and the smoothness of the trajectory, and the method is more suitable for path planning running in the underwater environment; and the visual SLAM is adopted for underwater mapping, and compared with sonar, the visual SLAM is lower in cost and easier to obtain, and the cost is lower.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Remote Well Stimulation Method
abstract: A method for stimulation of a subsea oil and gas well is provided, comprising the deploying a tree cap on a subsea well using a remotely operated vehicle (ROV), wherein the tree cap includes one or more fluid receptacles; deploying a rigless stimulation tool (RST) in a predetermined location on the sea floor away from the well and other subsea production system infrastructure; deploying at least one flexible well service jumper (WSJ) conduit having a first end connector and a second end connector from a well stimulation vessel (WSV), where the WSJ conduit includes a plurality of attached buoyant members sufficient to enable movement by the ROV under an overhead obstacle, such as a mobile offshore drilling unit or platform; and delivering a well stimulation fluid via the fluid stimulation conduits through the RST and via the WSJ conduit to the well.
note: well stimulation with a tree cap placed by an ROV

title: APPARATUS FOR PROVIDING INFORMATION RELATED MAINTENANCE OF UNMANNED AUTONOMOUS MOVING OBJECT AND UNMANNED AUTONOMOUS MOVING OBJECT HAVING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a device mounted on an unmanned autonomous vehicle to provide maintenance-related information of the unmanned autonomous vehicle, the unmanned autonomous vehicle having the same, and a method for providing information thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for providing maintenance information includes an electronic configuration disposed on an unmanned autonomous moving object to provide maintenance-related information of the unmanned autonomous moving object. The electronic configuration includes: a processor including a learning model; and a communication module receiving state data from sensors measuring states of propulsion components of the unmanned autonomous moving object. The processor inputs the state data into the learning model to determine the possibility of failure for the propulsion components, determines whether maintenance is necessary based on the possibility of failure, determines the type of failure related to the propulsion component determined to require maintenance, and generates maintenance information based on the determination result.
note: generic autonomous vehicle

title: Intelligent obstacle avoidance system and method for semi-submersible unmanned ship
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent obstacle avoidance system and a method for a semi-submersible unmanned ship, and relates to the technical field of underwater robot control. A sensing module is used for receiving obstacle information detected by the obstacle avoidance module, performing data optimization processing and transmitting the data to a control algorithm module; the control algorithm module receives the data optimized by the sensing module, establishes a semi-submersible unmanned ship motion model, plans an obstacle avoidance path, and controls the semi-submersible unmanned ship to avoid an obstacle in a circuitous path; a pressure depth gauge detects the depth of the semi-submersible unmanned ship, and an obstacle avoidance module used by the semi-submersible unmanned ship is determined according to a set threshold value; the obstacle avoidance system comprises an ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module, a sonar obstacle avoidance module and machine vision, cooperative use of the three modules is achieved through a combined optimization algorithm, efficient obstacle avoidance is achieved, and the advantages of all the modules are fully utilized. The obstacle avoidance module is switched and used by setting a threshold value and autonomously cooperates with the threshold value to form an obstacle avoidance system, obstacles are avoided through a circuitous path, and the circuitous path can cover all the ranges.
note: semi-submersible unmanned ship

title: Composite man-machine sharing cooperative control method for underwater operation robot
abstract: The invention discloses a composite man-machine sharing cooperative control method for an underwater operation robot, and the method comprises a robot modeling stage, an information collection stage, a motion mapping stage, a task distribution stage, a task priority separation type sharing control stage, and a force feedback stage. In the task allocation stage, tasks are divided into a joint constraint task, a mixed shared whole-body cooperative control task and an attitude optimization task; the joint constraint task is controlled by the autonomous system and used for preventing self-collision of the robot; the hybrid sharing whole-body cooperative control task is focused on motion control of the tail end of the underwater mechanical arm, the tail end of the underwater mechanical arm is controlled through a hybrid sharing control method, input of an operator and an autonomous system is fused, and motion distribution is conducted on an underwater vehicle and the underwater mechanical arm. The attitude optimization task is controlled by an autonomous system for assisting an operator in adjusting the viewing angle. According to the invention, self-obstacle avoidance and auxiliary attitude adjustment can be automatically realized, and man-machine sharing control is realized in an end operation task.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Non-destructive testing and cleaning apparatus
abstract: The present invention provides a non-destructive testing and cleaning apparatus. The present invention provides a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) that inspects and cleans a surface. The remotely operated vehicle (ROV) is an intelligent robotic vehicle that inspects and cleans the surface automatically. The remotely operated vehicle (ROV) includes an inspection module. The inspection module inspects the surface and allows the remotely operated vehicle (ROV) to move on a path along the surface. In addition, the remotely operated vehicle (ROV) includes a cleaning module. The cleaning module allows the remotely operated vehicle (ROV) to clean the pre-determined path along with the surface. Furthermore, the remotely operated vehicle (ROV) connected with a master control unit for providing commands to operate and control the remotely operated vehicle (ROV).
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Operating method of modular manned submersible capable of being freely matched
abstract: The invention relates to an operation method of a modular manned submersible capable of being freely matched, accurate function matching aiming at different task targets is realized by designing six independent modules and then through a modular functional unit assembly form, and the submersible has higher expansibility due to the superposable energy, power and buoyancy adjusting capacity, so that the operation of the modular manned submersible is facilitated. The underwater vehicle can cope with various targets such as operation, sailing, exploration, salvage, laying and recycling, unmanned reconnaissance and manned fine operation, the operation pertinence of the underwater vehicle is effectively improved, the ability to cope with complex operation is high enough, and excessive consumption is avoided when simple operation is coped with.
note: manned submersible

title: Multifunctional unmanned platform capable of conveniently collecting and releasing underwater detector
abstract: The invention provides a multifunctional unmanned platform capable of conveniently collecting and releasing an underwater detector, and relates to the technical field of underwater detection.The multifunctional unmanned platform comprises a frame body, a clamping assembly, a sensing device, a controller and a connecting assembly used for external fixation, a loading shell is arranged at one end of the frame body, and a containing channel used for storing the underwater detector is transversely arranged on the loading shell; the clamping assembly is fixedly connected to the front side of the loading shell and located at the front end of the containing channel, the sensing device is fixedly connected to the rear side of the loading shell and located at the rear end of the containing channel, the controller is fixedly connected into the frame body and located on one side of the loading shell, the controller is electrically connected with the clamping assembly and the sensing device, and a connecting column is arranged at the other end of the frame body. The connecting assembly is fixedly connected with one end of the connecting column; the multifunctional unmanned platform capable of conveniently collecting and releasing the underwater detector can be conveniently installed and fixed outwards, meanwhile, the underwater detector can be conveniently released and collected, and underwater detection operation of the underwater detector is facilitated.
note: surface platform releasing an underwater detector

title: Method and apparatus for transporting ballast and cargo in an autonomous vehicle
abstract: A field configurable autonomous vehicle includes modular elements and attachable components. The vehicle can be assembled from these modular elements and components to meet desired mission and performance characteristics without the need to purchase specially designed vehicles for each mission. The vehicle can include a mechanisms that magnetically attach and release payloads such as cargo or ballast from the vehicle.
note: field-configurable autonomous underwater vehicle

title: Collision avoidance method for underwater vehicle in multi-task mode
abstract: The invention discloses a collision avoidance method for an underwater vehicle in a multi-task mode, which comprises the following steps of: judging a navigation mode according to the scale, the navigation mode and the navigation water depth of the underwater vehicle; and applying corresponding collision avoidance strategies according to different navigation modes. In specific application, when sailing on the water surface, aiming at a working environment of a two-dimensional plane, a speed obstacle method is adopted, an international maritime collision avoidance rule is combined, and a ship sailing on the water surface is avoided; in the near-water-surface navigation stage, an artificial potential field method and a speed obstacle method are jointly applied, and the depth is adjusted to prevent stranding or rushing out of the water surface while water surface and underwater dynamic and static obstacles are avoided; in the deepwater navigation stage, the influence of the water surface is not considered, and for collision avoidance of a non-depth limited water area, a view cone method is applied to avoid dynamic and static obstacles in a three-dimensional space. According to the method, corresponding collision avoidance strategies are adopted according to navigation characteristics under different depths, and the intelligent level of navigation of the underwater vehicle under different task working conditions can be improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Waterborne intelligent carrying platform and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of a waterborne intelligent monitoring technology and in particular relates to a waterborne intelligent carrying platform and application thereof. A shellbody of a waterborne carrying platform body is a sealed shell body; a buoyancy ring is fixed at the outer part of the waterborne carrying platform body; a positioning module is used for acquiring geographical position information of the waterborne carrying platform body; a plurality of propellers are fixed at the bottom of the waterborne carrying platform body; an ultrasonic receiving energy transducer device is arranged at the outer part of the waterborne carrying platform body; one end of a data cable is communicated onto a communication module; the other end of the data cable is communicated onto a data acquisition module; systems are networked through the waterborne carrying platform and ways of exploring deep sea of human beings are enriched; the difficulty of exploring the sea area by human beings is reduced; a safe way is provided for maritime rescue and the safety of the maritime rescue is improved; the personal safety of rescuing workers is ensured, the cognition of people onthe underwater world is improved and the enthusiasm of exploring the sea area of human beings improved.
note: floating platform

title: Multi-towed-body full-navigation-state depth setting and vector laying technology
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-towed body full-navigation-state depth setting and vector laying technology, which comprises a towed body subsystem, a towing cable subsystem and a master control subsystem, and is characterized in that the towed body subsystem comprises two or more towed body structures, each towed body structure comprises a water surface floating body, an underwater towed body anda connecting cable, and at least two towed body structures comprise propelling devices; the underwater towed body can be suspended, towed and communicated with the outside through the connecting cable between the underwater towed body and the water surface floating body; the towed body subsystem can be towed to the rear by a carrier ship to implement monitoring operation, and after a main cable is cut off, the propelling device can push the towed body subsystem to move horizontally and complete the laying of the underwater towed body according to a specified shape, and can also assist the attached underwater towed body to perform depth setting control in the high-speed towed process. The system can carry out high-resolution synchronous real-time monitoring on wide-area and near-field strip-shaped water bodies in a full navigation state, and can meet the requirements of short-distance self-navigation and vector laying in a special scene.
note: towed bodies

title: Efficient teleoperation of mobile robots via online adaptation
abstract: Described herein is a framework for efficient task-agnostic, user-independent adaptive teleoperation of mobile robots and remotely operated vehicles (ROV), including ground vehicles (including legged systems), aircraft, watercraft and spacecraft. The efficiency of a human operator is improved by minimizing the entropy of the control inputs, thereby minimizing operator energy and achieving higher performance in the form of smoother trajectories by concurrently estimating the user intent online and adaptively updating the action set available to the human operator.
note: teleoperation of any mobile robot incl. ROVs

title: OBSTACLE AVOIDANCE METHOD AND DEVICE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow an underwater vehicle to move to a target position while avoiding an obstacle.SOLUTION: A target position direction going toward a target position from a current position of an underwater vehicle is determined. A travel direction of the underwater vehicle is determined to the target position direction. When there is an obstacle which is an avoidance object in a set area in the travel direction, obstacle avoidance processing is started. In the obstacle avoidance processing, first, the travel direction of the underwater vehicle is determined to a direction along the obstacle so that one of right and left sides of the travel direction of the underwater vehicle is along the obstacle, and then the underwater vehicle is moved. Then, when there is an obstacle in a set determination area in the target position direction from the current position of the underwater vehicle, the movement in the direction along the obstacle is continued. When the obstacle does not exist in the determination area any longer, the obstacle avoidance processing is finished, and then the underwater vehicle is moved to the target position direction in which the current position is a reference.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR RETROACTIVELY INSTALLING SENSORS ON MARINE ELEMENTS
abstract: Sensors, including fiber optic sensors and their umbilicals, are mounted on support structures designed to be retro-fitted to in-place structures, including subsea structures. The sensor support structures are designed to monitor structure conditions, including strain, temperature, and in the instance of pipelines, the existence of production slugs. Moreover the support structures are designed for installation in harsh environments, such as deep water conditions using remotely operated vehicles.

title: Water sealed culvert detecting robot system and implementation method
abstract: The invention relates to a water sealed culvert detecting robot system and an implementation method. The water sealed culvert detecting robot system comprises two parts which are an external remote control device and an underwater robot, wherein the underwater robot part comprises a boat body, a lighting device, an underwater sealed propeller, a detection sensing device, an electronic control system sealed cabin, an inertial navigation module and an executing device. The intelligent underwater working platform external remote control device is connected with the underwater robot through an umbilical cable; a power supply cable and a data transmission optical fiber are included in the umbilical cable; and the umbilical cable is connected with the underwater robot part by using a water sealed plug. After the robot is underwater, the underwater robot obtains underwater working environment information through the detection sensing device and transmits the information to an operator in time; the operator performs specific task operations of underwater or ocean engineering by using the external remote control device. According to the water sealed culvert detecting robot system, the underwater robot can accurately reach a designated underwater position, has the advantages of large range and small influence from weathers and can finish multiple underwater tasks while different working ends are carried on the executing device.
note: underwater robot inspecting water-sealed culverts

title: Coupling and support mechanism for bending stiffeners with single external drive
abstract: The present invention relates to coupling/uncoupling and support mechanisms for connecting bend stiffeners to bellmouths, and aims to optimize pull-in and pull-out operations, reduce operating costs and times, and also completely replace shallow dives by operations without associated man-hours exposed to risk, such as those carried out using remotely-operated vehicles (ROVs). The proposed solution envisages a mechanism for coupling/uncoupling and supporting a bend stiffener, comprising a frontal actuation means, which has the feature of being easy to access and operate using ROVs, thereby replacing the multiple latch mechanisms used previously.
note: bend-stiffener coupling replacing dives

title: Underwater three-dimensional detection system
abstract: The invention provides an underwater three-dimensional detection system. The underwater three-dimensional detection system comprises an unmanned ship module and a shore-based control module, the unmanned ship module comprises an unmanned ship body, a shipborne control system and a ship-based communication system; the unmanned ship carries an underwater robot unit and shipborne detection equipment; the shore-based control module comprises a post-processing module, a shore-based communication system and an unmanned ship display control system; remote control over the unmanned ship module is achieved through the shore-based control module; under an unmanned condition, detection data are automatically acquired through an underwater robot and various shipborne detection devices, the detection data are acquired in real time through a shore-based communication system, a post-processing result is output based on the detection data, and a visual interface is generated through an unmanned ship display control system, so that the bridge island tunnel and surrounding substrate environment can be more intuitively and accurately reflected; a reliable data analysis basis is provided for the environment evolution trend, and the defect of manual data collection is avoided.
note: unmanned survey ship alone

title: Deep-sea-oriented fault underwater vehicle positioning and search-and-rescue system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a deep-sea-oriented fault underwater vehicle positioning, searching and rescuing system and method. The system comprises a seabed environment construction module, an underwater vehicle position prediction module and an underwater vehicle searching module. The seabed environment construction module is used for constructing a seabed environment model of a sea area where the target underwater vehicle is located; the underwater vehicle position prediction module is used for constructing a position prediction model to predict the fault position of the target underwater vehicle in the seabed environment model when the target underwater vehicle breaks down; and the underwater vehicle searching module is used for searching and rescuing the target underwater vehicle based on the fault position. Aiming at the problems of position prediction and search and rescue of the deep-sea underwater vehicle, an underwater vehicle position prediction model based on federated Kalman filtering and a Markov chain Monte Carlo method is established, and searching and positioning of the underwater vehicle under the three conditions of normal navigation, power out-of-control and power failure are achieved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: SUBSEA COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY SYSTEM WITH FLAT PANEL DETECTORS
abstract: A Computed Tomography (CT) system can be deployed by subsea vehicles such as remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) or by divers to perform CT inspections on a subsea structure. In embodiments, a marinized signal source and a marinized flat panel signal detector are positioned at a structure to be inspected subsea and possibly repositioned at different angles about the structure to acquire a series of 2D radiographic images which are then fed to a reconstruction algorithm that produces a 3D reconstructed volume of the structure being inspected.
note: subsea CT system deployed by ROVs or divers

title: Towed underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean observation and relates to assistive technology of ocean observation, in particular to a towed underwater vehicle, mainly aiming at measurement of high-density section observation parameters in regional waters. The towed underwater vehicle comprises a carrying device, an adjusting mechanism and an internal control unit, wherein the carrying device is used for carrying underwater exploration instruments, the adjusting mechanism and the internal control unit, the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting running depth of the towed underwater vehicle, and the internal control unit is used for controlling the adjusting mechanism to enable the same to be capable of completing high-density section measurement. The towed underwater vehicle has the advantages that high-density section measurement can be completed without stopping of the towed underwater vehicle, so that time is saved; the towed underwater vehicle is capable of carrying multiple kinds of instruments, convenient to use and saving in cost; the towed underwater vehicle is high in maneuverability intrinsically and capable of achieving operation under multiple conditions, thereby being high in practical value; the towed underwater vehicle is quite small in size, thereby being carried conveniently during ocean expedition.
note: towed underwater vehicle

title: AUTOMATIC RESEARCH SYSTEM FOR UNMANNED AIRCRAFT AND METHOD OF AUTOMATIC RESEARCH FOR UNMANNED AIRCRAFT
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To automatically generate an observation route and allow an automatic observation of an underwater condition or a water bottom condition under the observation route.

SOLUTION: A reference observation line is input for generating the observation route (S1), a plurality of observation routes are generated by translating the reference observation line at a fixed distance (S2), the distances of the plurality of generated observation routes are determined and a navigation order of the determined observation routes is instructed (S3), an unmanned boat is automatically navigated according to the instructed navigation order (S4), at least an underwater or water bottom condition is observed during the navigation (S5), and at least the observed underwater or water bottom condition is displayed and stored (S6).

title: DETERMINING OBJECT INFORMATION USING ULTRASONIC DATA FOR AUTONOMOUS AND SEMI-AUTONOMOUS SYSTEMS AND APPLICATIONS
abstract: In various examples, techniques for sensor-fusion based object detection and/or free-space detection using ultrasonic sensors are described. Systems may receive sensor data generated using one or more types of sensors of a machine. In some examples, the systems may then process at least a portion of the sensor data to generate input data, where the input data represents one or more locations of one or more objects within an environment. The systems may then input at least a portion of the sensor data and/or at least a portion of the input data into one or more neural networks that are trained to output one or more maps or other output representations associated with the environment. In some examples, the map(s) may include a height, an occupancy, and/or height/occupancy map generated, e.g., from a birds-eye-view perspective. The machine may use these outputs to perform one or more operations.
note: no underwater drone

title: Unmanned plane and robot coordinated control system for underwater rescue
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned plane and a robot coordinated control system for underwater rescue. The system comprises three parts: a water surface communication device, a relay unmanned plane and a control center. The relay unmanned plane is a bridge for the information interaction between an underwater robot and the control center. When the control center sends order information to the underwater robot, the order information is firstly sent to the unmanned plane in the sky through radio waves and then is sent to an information receiving device of the underwater robot by the unmanned plane. By using the relay unmanned plane, the activity range of the underwater robot is extended greatly, the maneuverability of the underwater robot and the convenience of usage and maintenance are improved, the industrial promotion and application are facilitated.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: UNMANNED SEA EXPLORATION SYSTEM, MANAGEMENT DEVICE, AND CONTROL METHOD OF UNMANNED SEA EXPLORATION SYSTEM
abstract: To provide an inexpensive unmanned sea exploration system which enables a series of sea exploration work to be unmanned.SOLUTION: In an unmanned sea exploration system, a ship which can receive a steering signal, transmitted from an RC controller 23 through a predetermined network, through a transmitting and receiving antenna to navigate, a water drone 31 which conducts undersea exploration based on an exploration signal transmitted from the RC controller 23, and a management device 11 which processes exploration information transmitted from the ship 1 can communicate with each other. The unmanned sea exploration system receives the exploration information transmitted from the ship 1 to analyze geographical information of a sea bottom and shape information of a structure part installed on the sea bottom, creates a 3D sea bottom exploration image indicating sea bottom ground forms and sea bottom structures indicating an exploration result based on the analyzed exploration information, and links the created 3D sea bottom exploration image to a predetermined marine chart to accumulate the linked data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
note: remote-controlled exploration ship

title: Control system suitable for underwater vehicle water surface recovery and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a control system suitable for underwater vehicle water surface recovery and a control method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned ships. The control system for underwater vehicle water surface recovery comprises a double-body unmanned ship central control system, a double-body unmanned ship motion control system, a laser detection and visual identification module, an underwater vehicle recovery system, an underwater vehicle central control system and an underwater vehicle motion control system. An unmanned ship pose prediction model based on deep learning is designed in the double-body unmanned ship motion control system, prediction of unmanned ship pose data is achieved, and the precision of unmanned ship positioning and the stability of an underwater vehicle recovery platform are improved. Meanwhile, a self-adaptive sliding mode fault-tolerant tracking controller is designed in the motion control system of the underwater vehicle, so that the underwater vehicle has higher reliability and stability in the process of executing a recovery task. The underwater vehicle water surface recovery control system designed by the invention can effectively improve the recovery efficiency and success rate of the underwater vehicle, saves the recovery cost, and has certain practical value.
note: unmanned ship recovering an underwater vehicle

title: Ocean heterogeneous unmanned cluster platform system and method
abstract: The invention discloses an ocean heterogeneous unmanned cluster platform system and method, and belongs to the field of underwater unmanned cluster collaboration. Comprising a water surface unmanned static module, a water surface unmanned dynamic module and an underwater unmanned dynamic module which form a three-dimensional cluster in the ocean, and a shore base/command and control center for controlling the three-dimensional cluster, different unmanned clusters have capability complementation, and the method has great significance in improving the operation efficiency of ocean tasks. In order to improve task execution efficiency, unmanned ships and underwater vehicle unmanned clusters are connected into a whole on the basis of a single-domain cluster platform to form an ocean heterogeneous unmanned cluster system. Underwater cooperative detection, cooperative observation and cooperative search tracking are carried out by utilizing the complementary advantages of the platform, and the defects of communication and cooperative operation of heterogeneous clusters in the prior art are overcome.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR TRIGGERING AN ALARM DURING A SENSOR JAMMING ATTACK
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a storage device, for triggering an alarm during a sensor jamming attack. In one aspect, a monitoring system sensor unit is disclosed that includes a sensor, a communication unit configured to communicate with a monitoring system using a range of frequencies, and a jamming detection unit. The jamming detection unit may include a processor and a computer storage media storing instructions that, when executed by the processor, cause the processor to perform operations. The operations include detecting a sensor jamming event, selecting a different form of communication other than the range of radio frequencies for the communication unit to communicate with the monitoring system, and providing, to the communication unit, an instruction to communicate with the monitoring system using the form of communication, wherein the communication unit may communicate, to the monitoring system using the form of communication, the sensor data.
note: no underwater drone

title: Surface-assisted underwater exploration apparatus
abstract: Systems and methods to allow a user to be both towed by and control a personal flotation craft from behind and underneath while engaging in underwater exploration comprising one or more propulsion devices, an optionally foldable tow shaft and one or more directional controllers. Wherein the systems and methods may further comprises one or more remotely controllable speed modulators, controlled by a user from behind and underneath the personal flotation craft, while engaging in underwater exploration.
note: diver tow craft

title: SUBSEA ENERGY STORAGE FOR BLOW OUT PREVENTER (BOP)
abstract: A subsea energy storage for well control equipment, wherein stored energy near a well on the sea floor monitors and activates well control equipment independently of, or in conjunction with, hydraulic energy. Energy to the subsea energy storage can be supplied by surface umbilical, remotely- operated vehicle, or by subsea electrical generation from stored hydraulic energy. Stored electrical energy may also recharge stored hydraulic energy. A subsea control system is configured to record data, compare the data to predetermined event signatures, and operate the well control equipment with stored electrical energy.
note: subsea BOP energy storage, charged by ROV

title: Multi-sensing robot for underwater detection and use method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-sensing robot for underwater detection and a use method. The multi-sensing robot comprises a shell, a wheel foot module, a lifting module, a detection module and a control module. The shell is a square closed shell of which the center is provided with a circular cavity; the wheel foot module comprises at least two pairs of wheel foot assemblies, and each pair of wheel foot assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the shell. The lifting module is arranged in the circular cavity of the shell; the control module comprises an MCU unit, and the MCU unit is in communication connection with the wheel foot module, the lifting module, the detection module and the main control end and used for controlling the wheel foot module and the lifting module according to a control instruction of the main control end and information provided by the detection module. According to the amphibious robot, through cooperation of the wheel foot module, the lifting module and the gravity center adjusting module, posture adjustment, flexible movement and high-speed cruising of the robot in water can be achieved, self-camouflage can be achieved in the underwater cruising process, and the concealment is improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Multifunctional deploying and retracting cabin for modularized underwater intelligent equipment platform
abstract: The invention relates to a multifunctional deploying and retracting cabin for a modularized underwater intelligent equipment platform, and belongs to the field of underwater unmanned equipment. The system is composed of a cabin body, a cabin door, an empennage, a hanging ring, a photoelectric composite towing cable, a watertight photoelectric interface, a sliding rail, a ballast lead block, an underwater acoustic communication system and an underwater acoustic positioning system. The cabin body adopts an open type structural design, and all sensors and actuators of the modularized underwater intelligent equipment platform can work normally in the cabin body. According to the multifunctional deploying and retracting cabin, laying and recovery of the modular underwater intelligent equipment platform can be carried out, the modular underwater intelligent equipment platform can be assisted to realize switching between an autonomous cruise measurement mode and a fish dragging measurement mode, and the system has the advantages of high recovery and laying automation degree, prolongation of underwater working time of the modular underwater intelligent equipment platform, reduction of maintenance and use cost and the like; the modular underwater intelligent equipment platform can be helped to quickly complete role conversion according to task requirements, and the systematization and intelligence of the modular underwater intelligent unmanned equipment system are greatly improved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: SMART STATION SYSTEM FOR UNMANNED MOVING OBJECTS FOR OCEAN OBSERVATION
abstract: Disclosed is a smart station system for ocean observation using unmanned moving objects. The smart station system for ocean observation by unmanned moving objects according to the present invention comprises: a structure of which a part is submerged and the rest is exposed on the surface of the water; a first docking part arranged in the underwater area of the structure so that unmanned moving objects autonomously driving on the seabed or underwater can be docked; a second docking part arranged in the water surface area of the structure so that the unmanned moving objects autonomously driving on the water surface can be docked; and a third docking part arranged in an upper portion of the structure so that the unmanned moving objects autonomously driving in the air can be docked. A data transmitting and receiving part and a power supply part electrically connected to the docked unmanned moving object to transmit and receive data are respectively arranged in the first docking part, the second docking part, and the third docking part.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: DIVING AND RESCUE DEEP-SEA VEHICLE
abstract: FIELD: shipbuilding.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of shipbuilding, in particular to deep-sea vehicles in support of diving and rescue operations. A diving and rescue deep-sea vehicle is proposed, which includes a control compartment located in a solid hull, diving and rescue and energy compartments, a suction chamber, a propulsion and steering complex, instrumentation and electrical equipment, life support means, and also includes a device for fixing on the ground, and it is equipped with a descending and lifting device for divers. Life support means contain absorption equipment and gas medium monitoring equipment located in the control compartment of the vehicle and the diving and rescue compartment, and breathing masks and air collectors located in the diving and rescue compartment. In the inter-board space of a bow, there are a remote-controlled uninhabited underwater vehicle and a radio communication unit assembled by a pop-up buoy equipped with a receiving and transmitting antenna.EFFECT: increase in the quality of life support, autonomy and safety of a deep-sea vehicle with the possibility of independent search, guidance, remote inspection of an underwater object, as well as mechanization, reduction of energy consumption, improvement of the quality of communication with the control point of the carrier vessel, when performing diving and rescue operations without the involvement of the carrier vessel.1 cl, 3 dwg
note: crewed rescue vehicle

title: Self-propelled detector for water depth of navigation channel
abstract: The invention relates to a self-propelled detector for water depth of a navigation channel. The detector comprises a self-propelled hull which is provided with an acquisition device, a power system, a rudder, a wireless communication module, a GPS receiver, an energy transducer and a controller, wherein, the power system and the rudder are controlled by the controller, output signals of the GPS receiver and the energy transducer are input into the controller through the acquisition device, the controller communicates with the outer through the wireless communication module, a groove is provided at the bottom of the self-propelled hull, the energy transducer is arranged in the groove, a connecting rod is provided in the groove, one end of the connecting rod is connected with the energy transducer, and the other end of the connecting rod is hinged to the self-propelled hull. According to the invention, the energy transducer is guaranteed to be completely immersed in water, and when affected by shaking of the hull, no matter it is transverse shaking or longitudinal shaking, the energy transducer is capable of carrying out adjustment based on gravity of itself and always maintains perpendicular to a horizontal plane, thereby enabling measuring precision to be obtained; the application of the self-propelled hull enables work intensity of workers to be mitigated, cost to be lowered down and occurrence probability of accidents caused by stranding to be reduced.
note: self-propelled surface depth sounder

title: System and method for user-driven real-time photogrammetry with dynamic camera allocation and positioning
abstract: A system for user-driven real-time (live) photogrammetry comprises: plural movable platforms 1, such as drones, remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) or autonomous vehicles, equipped with cameras 2-4; image processing unit 5 generating a live three-dimensional (3D) model 6 from received camera images; user interface 7 displaying the live 3D model to remote viewer 8 and capturing user inputs representing virtual navigation (and focus areas) within the 3D model; and a control unit 9 that adjusts, using an adaptive coverage algorithm, the numbers and positions (including orientations) of active cameras (via the moving platforms) in real-time. The algorithm may prioritise camera resources to areas of high user interest while maintaining minimum coverage thresholds elsewhere. User interface 7 may provide visual indicators of data freshness and coverage quality within the live 3D model. Predictive algorithms or historical interaction data may be used to anticipate user focus areas and proactively adjust or optimise camera positions. Reallocation of cameras from over-sampled to under-sampled areas, alerts if certain areas cannot be adequately covered, and a user camera override to focus on specific areas, may be provided.
note: photogrammetry with drones or ROVs, any medium

title: S face control method of flotation under water robot motion
abstract: An S-surface control method for the movement of the pelagic underwater robot includes such steps as using short base line and depth meter to obtain position information, using compass to obtain attitude angle, using Doppler speedmeter to obtain speed, calculating by controller, executing movement via propeller, wings and helm, using 6-freedom position offset and variation rate as input for position control and location, using 6-freedom speed offset and variation rate as input for controlling speed, and using the indexing of PD control for non-linear control.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Autonomous robotic forest rover for automated resin collection
abstract: Provided are robotic systems and methods for identifying a particular type of tree or plant (e.g., slash pine trees), for tapping them and collect their oleoresin for processing using an autonomous, long-range robotic forest rover. One aspect of the system comprises an autonomous vehicle equipped with an industrial robot, automated tool changer, a plurality of tools required for robotic operations, vision and navigation systems and powertrain for long-range operation. The rover identifies healthy, mature trees or plants, approaches them and performs the robotic operations required for tapping the trees or plants. In addition to these tasks, the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) coordinates of the tree or plant is recorded along with its diameter, and a digital image of the tree or plant. This information is communicated to a base station for creating and updating a tree farm database.

title: METHOD OF THE UNDERWATER FACILITY PROTECTION
abstract: FIELD: active protection devices.SUBSTANCE: subsea facility protection method using the submersible guardian device (SGD) is in the SGD preparation for launch by the on-board control system (BCS) testing, to which the movement program and the task are entered. Launching the SGD from protected facility or carrier, switching on the BSU into operation, by which commands controlling the SGD movement. Calculating and adjusting the path, using the navigational instruments updating the geographical coordinates, maneuvering the SGD and keeping the set position and depth. Detecting the target and attacking using the mines or performing the target audible or visual warning of its detection. As the SGD, using the autonomous uninhabited underwater vehicle with propulsion unit and power-generating unit, including chemical current source and electric motor. Equipping the SGD and the protected underwater facility with mutual recognition devices, monitoring the SGD location using the radio and / or laser communication lines.EFFECT: enabling the underwater facility secret protection using the SGD and SGD operations remote control, in case of foreign targets detection, warning them, announcing alarm or attack.1 cl
