title: Underwater sounding method of unmanned aerial vehicle carrying detection device
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater sounding method of an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying detection device, which adopts an unmanned aerial vehicle group to hoist an inverted pyramid structure rigid frame, the lower end of the frame is provided with a vertical long rod through a universal ball joint, and the top end of the long rod is fixedly provided with a GPS antenna disc. A damping balancing weight, a first water level sensor, a second water level sensor and a detector are sequentially arranged on the long rod from top to bottom at intervals. After the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying detection device flies to the position above the detected position, the flight height is reduced, when the first water level sensor detects that the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying detection device does not enter water and the second water level sensor detects that the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying detection device enters water, it shows that the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying detection device reaches a proper measurement height, the unmanned aerial vehicle group starts a hovering mode, and a GPS main body measures an elevation value of a GPS antenna disc at the top end of a long rod; the underwater depth is obtained by the detector, and the underwater elevation of the detected point can be calculated according to the distance between the GPS antenna disc and the depth finder. According to the invention, rapid, accurate and low-cost detection of the water body bottom elevation can be realized.
note: aerial drones hoisting a sounding frame

title: Self-propulsion energy self-supply deep sea power generation and detection device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater navigation, and particularly discloses a self-propulsion energy self-supply deep sea power generation and detection device which comprises a power generation cabin and variable-pitch cabins arranged at the two ends of the power generation cabin, wherein propelling cabins are arranged on the sides, which are away from the power generation cabin, of the variable-pitch cabins on the two sides, an energy storage cabin and a communication cabin are arranged in the power generation cabin, the power generation cabin and the variable-pitch cabin are separated through a metal sheet, propellers are arranged on the sides, which are away from the variable-pitch cabin, of the propelling cabins on the two sides, a vertical via hole is formed in the middle of the power generation cabin, a propeller is installed in the vertical via hole, a vertical propeller is installed on the propeller, the power generation cabin, the variable-pitch cabin and the propelling cabin are connected through flanges, a generator turbine is arranged in the variable-pitch cabin, a seabed power generation device utilizes ocean current energy to conduct energy self-supplementation and has the self-propulsion capacity, and meanwhile, the seabed power generation device has the function of supplying power to other seabed detection equipment, and after carrying other seabed detection equipment, the device also has seabed detection capability.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Multi-rotor flying platform for water depth detection, detection system and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a multi-rotor flying platform for water depth detection, a detection system and a detection method thereof, and a flying platform body comprises a cabin, a machine arm and a power system; the unmanned aerial vehicle further comprises a detection sonar transducer device, the lower end of the cabin is connected with the detection sonar transducer device through a rigid connecting device, and the detection system comprises a control module, a detection module, a GNSS system module, a ground station system and a flight control system. The detection method comprises the steps that the ground station end controls the multi-rotor flight platform load detection system to fly to a detected water area, the flight platform flies or hovers on the water surface, the transducer of the detection system stretches into the water surface, the water depth is calculated and detected through the sonar photoelectric conversion principle of the sonar transducer device, GNSS differential data is combined, and the detection precision is improved. Coordinates and elevation of a water bottom point can be obtained without being influenced by terrain and flow velocity of a water area, the defect of water depth measurement of a traditional unmanned depth measurement ship is overcome, and huge social benefits can be generated.
note: aerial drone for water depth

title: AUTOMATED OCEAN BOTTOM SEISMIC NODE IDENTIFICATION, TRACKING, DEPLOYMENT, AND RECOVERY SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A system, apparatus, and method for individually identifying, handling, tracking, deploying, and recovering a plurality of seismic nodes by an underwater vehicle for subsea operations. The deployment and positioning and retrieval of seismic nodes to and from the seabed may be managed automatically by software and/or manually automated by an ROV operator. The disclosed system may be coupled to a ROV navigation system. The node identification system tracks the position of each seismic node (associated with a unique identification number) within each tray or other node holder at all times, whether the tray is located on board a surface vessel, within an ROV, within a subsea basket, or on the seabed. The identification system is configured to track, select, deploy, and recover a particular seismic node by its unique identification number.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater vehicle carrying cluster unmanned aerial vehicle device
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater vehicle carrying cluster unmanned aerial vehicle device which comprises an underwater vehicle attitude control module, an underwater vehicle motion compensation module, an unmanned aerial vehicle automatic receiving and transmitting module and an unmanned aerial vehicle honeycomb storage module. The underwater vehicle attitude control modules are arranged on the side face and the middle of the underwater vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle motion compensation module is arranged on the top of the underwater vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle automatic receiving and transmitting module is arranged on the upper portion of the interior of the underwater vehicle, and the unmanned aerial vehicle honeycomb storage modules are arranged in the center and the side face of the underwater vehicle. The underwater vehicle attitude control module is distributed on the outer side of the unmanned aerial vehicle honeycomb storage module, and the unmanned aerial vehicle automatic receiving and transmitting module is arranged above the unmanned aerial vehicle honeycomb storage module. Storage of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is achieved through a decentralized and distributed cellular storage structure, safety guarantee and endurance guarantee can be provided for operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be safely applied to the ocean operation process, and the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster storage method has great practical significance for achieving unmanned and intelligent ocean operation.
note: underwater vehicle carrying aerial drones

title: Method for autonomous obstacle avoidance in three-dimensional navigation of underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a method for autonomous obstacle avoidance in three-dimensional navigation of an underwater vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: S1, setting no less than one ranging sonar on the underwater vehicle; s2, detecting the position of an obstacle in a set range through a ranging sonar; and S3, carrying out region division on the detected obstacle. According to the method for autonomous obstacle avoidance in three-dimensional navigation of the underwater vehicle, operation is carried out according to a predefined path or task, and the underwater vehicle is allowed to deviate from a predicted task route through an autonomous avoidance system and returns after leaving the obstacle.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater remain exploring method based on data communication
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater remain exploring method based on data communication. The method comprises the steps that 1, an underwater remain exploring system based on data communication is provided and comprises an underwater robot body, a remain detection device and an overwater processing device, and the remain detection device is located on the underwater robot body and used for detecting whether remains exit underwater or not, and remain relevant information is transmitted to the overwater processing device through the underwater robot body when remains are detected; 2, the exploring system is used for exploring remains. By means of the underwater remain exploring method based on data communication, underwater remains can be automatically recognized, and the recognized underwater remains are positioned, so that underwater rescuing difficulty is lowered.

title: RISERLESS MODULAR SUBSEA WELL INTERVENTION, METHOD AND APPARATUS
abstract: A blowout preventer for a subsea well includes an electrical communication link 112 between a surface controller and a subsea controller; and a hydraulic link 116 between the subsea controller 108 and a subsea source of hydraulic fluid. The electrical link is created by a remotely operated vehicle 100A, possibly via its tether management system 102A. The fluid source may be housed on a skid 118, and positioned on the seabed. The system can include an accumulator and a pump.
note: BOP link created by an ROV

title: Naval vessel integrated navigation system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a naval vessel integrated navigation system and method. The system comprises a radar detection module used for detecting obstacles around a naval vessel; the ship automatic identification module is used for identifying ship position information, navigational speed information and course information of other water surface targets within the peripheral sight distance so as to prevent the other water surface targets from colliding with a naval ship; the combined navigation module is used for acquiring position information, navigational speed information and course information of a naval vessel; the combined navigation module receives a starting instruction sent by the display control module and transmits acquired information to the display control module; the sounding module provides water depth information for the naval vessel to prevent the naval vessel from driving into a water area with the water depth smaller than the set depth; the depth measurement module receives a depth measurement instruction sent by the display control module and transmits acquired information to the display control module; and the display control module plans a course route for the naval vessel and sends a driving instruction to the naval vessel to realize automatic driving. According to the invention, natural environment detection, target identification, autonomous obstacle avoidance and independent path planning can be realized.
note: no underwater drone

title: Obstacle avoiding device of underwater vehicle
abstract: The present invention relates to an obstacle avoiding device for an underwater vehicle and, more specifically, an obstacle avoiding device for an underwater vehicle, wherein the underwater vehicle is possible to avoid an obstacle during an operation by being provided with an avoiding device on a stern of the underwater vehicle for not losing an operation capability because of being hanged on the obstacle such as a fishing net at the bottom of an ocean when operating the underwater vehicle such as an unmanned submarine. The present invention is provided to the underwater vehicle such as the unmanned submarine and includes: a detection part detecting the obstacle ahead when the underwater vehicle moves underwater; a control part receiving a detection signal of the detection part; and a shooting part shot toward the obstacle by determination of the control part.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Vertical glider robot
abstract: A subsea vertical glider robot which supports deployment in subsea oilfield activities is disclosed. This vertical glider robot can also be used in oceanographic research exploration. One application of this vertical glider robot is the autonomous delivery of equipment and sensor systems to a precise predetermined location on the sea floor. The vertical glider robot is deployed from a surface ship or any other suitable sea surface platform and allowed to free fall to the bottom of the ocean. The traversal through the body of water is performed primarily by converting initial potential energy of the apparatus into kinetic energy, it does not use propellers. The traversing of the seafloor is controlled with a steering module that refines orientation while processing information about the vertical glider robot's current position and the target where it has to land.

title: Scuttle module for field configurable vehicle
abstract: A field configurable autonomous vehicle includes modular elements and attachable components. The vehicle can be assembled from these modular elements and components to meet desired mission and performance characteristics without the need to purchase specially designed vehicles for each mission. The vehicle can include a module that enables the vehicle to be scuttled or destroyed.
note: field-configurable autonomous underwater vehicle

title: Underwater vehicle
abstract: Various aspects can be implemented to provide a reconfigurable underwater vehicle. In general, one aspect of the subject matter described in this specification can be embodied in a underwater vehicle that includes a hull that is angular in shape and capable of avoiding sonar detection. The hull can include a bow and a stern that are substantially similar in shape. The underwater vehicle can also include a plurality of reconfigurable modules that are interconnected to form the hull of the underwater vehicle. Each reconfigurable module is capable of performing a different function associated with operation of the underwater vehicle. Further, the plurality of reconfigurable modules can be built in a warehouse away from a shipyard and assembled to form the underwater vehicle at the shipyard.
note: reconfigurable low-signature underwater vehicle; crew not stated

title: CONTROL SYSTEM, CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: [Problem] To enable improvement in performance of monitoring and tracking of a moving body moving in a marine area or the like by means of a plurality of unmanned vessels. [Solution] The present invention is a control system that detects an object by means of a plurality of unmanned vessels capable of navigating on the water surface or in the water, said control system comprising: a measurement unit that acquires measured data using a measurement sensor mounted on each of the plurality of unmanned vessels; an object detection determination unit that processes the measured data to detect the object; an object analysis determination unit that determines at least one of the type, operation status, and dynamic performance of the detected object; and an unmanned vessel operation management unit that issues an operation command to the plurality of unmanned vessels. The unmanned vessel operation management unit determines the command content of the operation command for the plurality of unmanned vessels in accordance with the determination result from the object analysis determination unit.
note: unmanned surface vessels alone

title: Lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method based on unmanned ship and apparatus thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of lake monitoring, and concretely relates to a lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method based on an unmanned ship. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a cruise instruction, programming several target points, forming a spiral cruise path; carrying out the spiral path cruise, recording a plane coordinate and water level elevation of each target position; drafting a underwater three dimensional map according to the recorded plane coordinate and the water level elevation, and calculating storage capacity through a contour volumemethod; and performing multitime cruise and calculating the dynamic storage capacity. According to the lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method based on the unmanned ship, the three-dimensionaltopographic map is drafted by programming the spiral path cruise detection, automatic monitoring and analysis of the dynamic storage capacity is carried out, and the lake dynamic storage capacity monitoring method has the advantages of high efficiency, high precision and high reliability.
note: unmanned surface ship alone

title: Underwater mechanical arm dragging control method and mechanical arm system
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater mechanical arm dragging control method and a mechanical arm system, and is suitable for the fields of ocean exploration, deep sea operation and the like. According to the method, dragging control input of an operator is received through a force feedback handle or virtual reality equipment, and input signals are converted into motion instructions of all joints of the mechanical arm through an inverse kinematics formula. The system is provided with a force sensor and an attitude sensor, feedback data of the underwater environment is collected in real time, the motion trail of the mechanical arm is dynamically optimized based on a PID control algorithm, and high precision and flexibility of the mechanical arm are kept in the complex underwater environment. The system has a multi-degree-of-freedom design and can execute diversified fine operation tasks, a force feedback mechanism ensures that an operator perceives force changes in real time, and the safety and accuracy of operation are improved. The wireless communication module ensures stable transmission of underwater signals, realizes remote operation and real-time feedback, and is suitable for complex underwater operation scenes.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Automatic planning and decision-making method for multi-working-condition navigation whole process of underwater manned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a full-process automatic planning and decision-making method for multi-working-condition navigation of an underwater manned underwater vehicle, which comprises a full-process automatic planning and decision-making system, and the full-process automatic planning and decision-making system comprises a human-computer interaction display and control interface, an electronic chart module, an automatic planning module and an automatic path planning module. According to the method, navigation planning is refined into navigation working condition planning and navigation path planning, navigation working condition planning is carried out in a state machine directed graph mode, and a single voyage number of the underwater vehicle is divided into a combined sequence of multiple working conditions; and a navigation path under a specific working condition is automatically planned by using a planning area adaptive improved A * algorithm.
note: manned underwater vehicle

title: Deep sea autonomous environment monitoring platform with autonomous movement and multi-station fixed-point monitoring
abstract: The invention provides a deep sea autonomous environment monitoring platform with autonomous movement and multi-station fixed-point monitoring, and relates to the field of deep sea environment monitoring. The autonomous moving and multi-station fixed-point monitoring deep sea autonomous environment monitoring platform comprises a diving shell, the diving shell is provided with a sonar detection device, an environment monitoring device, a water control device and six driving mechanisms, and the interior of the diving shell is fixedly connected with two isolation plates. The autonomous moving and multi-station fixed-point monitoring deep-sea autonomous environment monitoring platform ensures that the deep-sea autonomous environment monitoring platform consisting of the diving shell, the environment monitoring equipment, the signal transceiver, the water control equipment, the sonar detection equipment, the sampling pipe, the driving mechanism, the electric push rod, the rotating motor, the hydraulic cylinder and the like can quickly monitor the marine environment; the current situation that a monitoring platform can only be driven by using a marine scientific research ship is improved, the participation degree of workers is reduced, errors possibly caused by manual control are reduced, and the marine environment monitoring efficiency is guaranteed.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: METHOD FOR HANDLING MALFUNCTIONING VEHICLES ON A TRACK SYSTEM AND A STORAGE AND RETRIEVAL SYSTEM USING SUCH A METHOD
abstract: A method and associated system for handling a faulty vehicle on a track system, the track system constituting part of a storage and retrieval system, the track system forming a grid pattern of adjacent cells, the storage and retrieval system comprising a plurality of remote control vehicles configured to move laterally on the track system, each of the plurality of remotely controlled vehicles includes a drive wheel, and a control system for wirelessly monitoring and controlling movement of the plurality of remotely controlled vehicles, the control system performing, via wireless data communication, at least the following steps: detecting anomalies of operating conditions of the vehicles on the track system; registering the vehicle with the abnormal operation condition as a fault vehicle; registering a stop position of the faulty vehicle relative to the support rail system; a two-dimensional shutdown area is arranged on the track system; commanding the remote control vehicle running in the shutdown area to move out of the shutdown area, stop or a combination thereof; and indicating that an external operator is allowed to enter the entrance zone such that a human operator can enter the entrance zone through the doorway.

title: System to monitor the immersion of a submarine vehicle (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: System to monitor the immersion of an underwater vehicle. The invention relates to a system (10) for monitoring the immersion of a submarine vehicle (11) comprising at least one sensing device (13), and characterized in that it comprises a module (12) for the acquisition of the data provided by the sensory device (13) relating to the immersion of the underwater vehicle (11); a module (14) for processing said data; a module (15) for viewing the processed data; and a communication bus (17) interconnecting the acquisition module (12), the processing module (14) and the data display module (15). The system of the invention allows to improve the navigation of the submarine vehicle. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title: Robot intelligent control method, system and device and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a robot intelligent control method, system and device and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining underwater environment information of an invisible environment and collecting current motion data of a robot; the underwater environment information comprises a distance metric map between the robot and an obstacle in an invisible environment; detecting corresponding line segments of the walls in the distance metric map to obtain a candidate line segment library of all the walls in the invisible environment; based on the candidate line segment library, static positioning information of the robot is determined; updating dynamic positioning information of the robot based on the current motion data; and based on the static positioning information or the dynamic positioning information, a robot fan-shaped dredging route is constructed, a corresponding robot moving instruction is generated, and the robot moving instruction is used for controlling the robot to execute automatic cruise in a fan-shaped motion mode. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of underwater robot control.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Underwater vehicle autonomous swimming control method based on Auco code and underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an autonomous swimming control method for an underwater vehicle based on Auco codes and the underwater vehicle, and relates to the field of underwater vehicle control, a plurality of Auco codes for assisting positioning are pre-arranged in a to-be-cruised area, an initial cruising path is determined, the underwater vehicle is controlled to move along the path, a first image is acquired through an image acquisition module, and the first image is acquired through an image processing module; when it is judged that at least two Aruco codes exist in the first image, the current position coordinate is determined according to the image and a preset underwater global coordinate graph, the underwater positioning mode is reliable and efficient, and it is ensured that the aircraft moves according to the initial cruise path; and determining an obstacle avoidance path from the obstacle avoidance starting point to the obstacle avoidance ending point according to a preset real-time obstacle avoidance algorithm when the obstacle is judged to appear, so as to control the underwater vehicle to continuously move along the initial cruise path after moving along the obstacle avoidance path to avoid the obstacle, and finally reliably arrive at the cruise ending point. According to the scheme, autonomous swimming control over the underwater vehicle can be reliably achieved, and sensing of the to-be-cruised area is achieved.
note: underwater drone, part, infrastructure or method

title: Water surface and underwater integrated navigation method and device for small unmanned autonomous vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater robot technology, and aims to provide a water surface and underwater integrated navigation method and device for a small unmanned autonomous vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: simultaneously carrying an inertial navigation system (INS) and a satellite navigation system (NSS) on the S-ASUV; when working on the water surface, an INS/NSS loose integrated navigation mode is adopted, and the INS and the NSS independently work; when the NSS receiver is in a normal working state, performing real-time positioning and navigation by using the NSS; when the NSS signal cannot be received, adopting an INS/model aided navigation mode, and performing position calibration and navigation by using the NSS signal after the recovery signal is received; during underwater work, an INS/model aided navigation mode is adopted, that is, on the premise of not increasing hardware, a Kalman filter is adopted to fuse the kinetic models of the INS and the S-ASUV so as to realize aided navigation. The method is simple in steps and low in cost; stability, reliability and accurate result are realized; the application range is wide, and the method can be applied to navigation control of water surface and underwater vehicles in various shapes at the same time.

title: COMPOSITE AUTONOMOUS UNINHABITED UNDERWATER VEHICLE
abstract: FIELD: vehicles.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of means for development of the global ocean and search for sunken objects. Proposed is a composite autonomous uninhabited underwater vehicle including a streamlined hull, equipped with propellers, accumulator batteries, tools for navigation and searching for sunken objects, wherein secured on lodgements with grips under the hull of the autonomous uninhabited carrier vehicle is a working apparatus, remote-controlled via a fibre-optic cable, equipped with video cameras and working manipulators, wherein a winch with a fibre-optic cable is placed in the lower part of the hull of the carrier vehicle, and secured on top of the hull of the autonomous carrier vehicle is a streamlined antenna module for a radio beacon, wherein a winch with a cable is also installed, and the floating radio beacon with control communication line equipment and a satellite navigation unit is connected to said cable.EFFECT: increase in the efficiency and productivity of search and exploration and underwater technical work in a wide range of depths.1 cl, 2 dwg
